视觉语言模型是「盲」的：无法把精细的视觉特征转译为文字

Vision language models are blind: Failing to translate detailed visual features into words

arXiv:2407.06581 · 作者：Pooyan Rahmanzadehgervi, Logan Bolton, Mohammad Reza Taesiri, Anh Totti Nguyen · 发布：2024-07-09 · arXiv 页面 · 原版 PDF · 原文 HTML
← 返回总目录

中文摘要

尽管具备视觉能力的大语言模型（VLM，如 GPT-4o 与 Gemini 1.5 Pro）在许多视觉理解基准上得分很高，它们在处理对人类而言轻而易举的低层视觉任务时依然吃力。具体地，在我们包含 7 项极简单任务的 BlindTest 上——包括判断（a）两个圆是否重叠；（b）两条直线相交几次；（c）单词中哪个字母被圈住；（d）类奥运标志中有几个圆——四款当前最优的 VLM 平均准确率仅为 58.07%。Claude 3.5 Sonnet 表现最好，准确率为 77.84%，远未达到人类预期的 100%。在各种图像分辨率与线宽下，包括慢思考模型在内的 VLM 一致地在那些需要精确空间信息、且几何图元相互重叠或彼此靠近的任务上表现挣扎。然而，当在形状与字母之间加入更多空间使之分离时，VLM 的准确率可达接近 100%。线性探测实验表明，视觉编码器含有足以解决 BlindTest 的视觉信息，而语言模型未能把这些信息解码为正确答案。代码与数据见：https://vlmsareblind.github.io

Abstract (原文)

While large language models with vision capabilities (VLMs), e.g., GPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Pro, score high on many vision-understanding benchmarks, they are still struggling with low-level vision tasks that are easy to humans. Specifically, on BlindTest, our suite of 7 very simple tasks, including identifying (a) whether two circles overlap; (b) how many times two lines intersect; (c) which letter is being circled in a word; and (d) the number of circles in an Olympic-like logo, four state-of-the-art VLMs are only 58.07% accurate on average. Claude 3.5 Sonnet performs the best at 77.84% accuracy, far from the human expected accuracy of 100%. Across different image resolutions and line widths, VLMs including slow-thinking models consistently struggle with those tasks that require precise spatial information when geometric primitives overlap or are close. Yet, VLMs perform at near-100% accuracy when much more space is added to separate shapes and letters. Linear probing experiments show that vision encoders contain sufficient visual information to solve BlindTest and that language models fail to decode this information into correct answers. Code and data are at: https://vlmsareblind.github.io

While large language models with vision capabilities (VLMs), e.g., GPT-4o and Gemini-1.5 Pro, score high on many vision-understanding benchmarks, they are still struggling with low-level vision tasks that are easy to humans. Specifically, on BlindTest, our suite of 7 very simple tasks, including identifying (a) whether two circles overlap; (b) how many times two lines intersect; (c) which letter is being circled in a word; and (d) the number of circles in an Olympic-like logo, four state-of-the-art VLMs are only 58.07% accurate on average. Sonnet-3.5 performs the best at 77.84% accuracy, far from the human expected accuracy of 100%. Across different image resolutions and line widths, VLMs including slow-thinking models consistently struggle with those tasks that require precise spatial information when geometric primitives overlap or are close. Yet, VLMs perform at near-100% accuracy when much more space is added to separate shapes and letters. Linear probing experiments show that vision encoders contain sufficient visual information to solve BlindTest and that language models fail to decode this information into correct answers. Code and data are at: VLMsAreBlind.github.io

1 Introduction

1 引言

The advent of VLMs, starting with GPT-4V(ision) [39], has enabled numerous, unprecedented image-text processing applications [53]. VLMs can accurately identify objects in a scene [42, 9, 53] and perform complex tasks based on these detected objects, e.g., calculating the cost of beers on a table from an image of the scene and an image of the menu [54]. Interestingly, VLMs advance so quickly that describing unusual activities in an image [46] (e.g., a man ironing on a moving taxi) has become a standard sanity check [10].

自 GPT-4V(ision) [39] 问世以来，视觉语言模型（VLM）催生了大量前所未有的图文处理应用 [53]。VLM 能准确识别场景中的物体 [42, 9, 53]，并基于这些被检测到的物体完成复杂任务，例如根据场景照片与菜单照片计算桌上啤酒的价格 [54]。有意思的是，VLM 的进展之快，以至于描述图像中的异常活动 [46]（例如一名男子在行驶的出租车上熨衣服）已经成为一种常规的有效性检验 [10]。

Existing VLM benchmarks cover a wide range of tasks [57, 18, 30]. However, they often assess a high-level human-vs-machine performance gap conflating both visual and non-visual abilities. Interestingly, the input images in so many questions, e.g., 42.9% of MMMU [57], are not even necessary [6] for determining the correct answer. Many answers (1) can be inferred from the textual question and choices alone [6, 13]; and (2) are memorized by VLMs from their Internet-scale training [6]. In contrast, it is important to exclusively measure the visual capabilities of VLMs, independent of their strong language abilities.

现有的 VLM 基准覆盖了广泛的任务 [57, 18, 30]。然而，它们衡量的往往是人与机器之间的高层性能差距，把视觉能力与非视觉能力混为一谈。有意思的是，在如此多的问题中——例如 MMMU [57] 中的 42.9%——输入图像对判定正确答案而言甚至并非必要 [6]。许多答案（1）仅凭文本问题与选项即可推出 [6, 13]；（2）由 VLM 从互联网规模的训练中记住 [6]。相比之下，独立于其强大的语言能力、专门度量 VLM 视觉能力，就显得十分重要。

In this paper, we test VLMs’ ability to see (not reasoning) on low-level vision tasks inspired by the “visual acuity” tests [5] given to humans by optometrists. We test four state-of-the-art (SOTA) VLMs: GPT-4o [38], Gemini-1.5 Pro [43], Claude-3 Sonnet [4], and Claude-3.5 Sonnet [2] on our suite of 7 extremely simple visual tasks that involve only 2D geometric primitives (e.g., lines and circles) [14] and require minimal world knowledge. Our key findings are:

本文受验光师为人类所做的「视敏度」测试 [5] 启发，用低层视觉任务来检验 VLM「看见」（而非推理）的能力。我们在 7 项极简单的视觉任务上测试四款当前最优（SOTA）的 VLM：GPT-4o [38]、Gemini-1.5 Pro [43]、Claude-3 Sonnet [4] 与 Claude-3.5 Sonnet [2]。这些任务只涉及二维几何图元（例如直线与圆）[14]，且只需极少的世界知识。我们的核心发现如下：

  • 1.

    Despite excellent performance on chart and diagram benchmarks [38, 4], VLMs cannot reliably tell whether two lines (or two circles) are intersecting, especially when close together. Accuracy in detecting 0, 1 or 2 intersections in a line chart of two 2-segment piecewise-linear functions ranges from ∼\sim41% to 76% (Sec. 4.1). For the two-circle task, VLMs perform better (∼\sim75–93% accuracy), but still far from the expected 100% (Sec. 4.2).

    • 1. 尽管在图表与示意图基准上表现出色 [38, 4]，VLM 却无法可靠判断两条线（或两个圆）是否相交，尤其当二者靠得很近时。在折线图 中判断两条两段分段线性函数的交点为 0、1 还是 2，准确率介于 ∼\sim41% 到 76% 之间（第 4.1 节）。对两圆 任务，VLM 表现更好（∼\sim75–93% 准确率），但仍远未达到预期的 100%（第 4.2 节）。

  • 2.

    VLMs can perfectly recognize a circle () and a word ( Subdermatoglyphic ) separately. Yet, when the circle is superimposed on the word (), models tend to struggle to identify which letter is being circled (Sec. 4.3).

    • 2. VLM 能分别完美识别一个圆（）和一个单词（ Subdermatoglyphic ）。然而，一旦把圆叠加到单词上（），模型往往难以辨认被圈出的是哪个字母（第 4.3 节）。

  • 3.

    VLMs can accurately count shapes, e.g., circles ( ○ ), that are disjoint and far apart. However, all VLMs struggle to count intersecting circles (like the Olympic logo), and, generally, primitive shapes ( ○ , □\Box , ⬠ ) that are overlapping or nested (Sec. 4.4).

    • 3. VLM 能准确清点彼此分离、相距较远的形状，例如圆（ ○ ）。然而，所有 VLM 都难以清点相交的圆 （如奥运标志那样），也难以清点一般意义上相互重叠或嵌套的图元形状（ ○ ，□\Box ， ⬠ ）（第 4.4 节）。

  • 4.

    Tiling up squares into a grid , we find VLMs to fail to count the number of rows or columns in the grid, whether empty or containing text (Sec. 4.5). This is in stark contrast to VLM high performance (≥\geq 90% accuracy) [38, 43] on DocVQA [31], which includes many questions with tables.

    • 4. 把正方形平铺成网格 后，我们发现 VLM 无法数清网格的行数或列数，无论格子为空还是含有文字（第 4.5 节）。这与 VLM 在 DocVQA [31] 上的高表现（≥\geq 90% 准确率）[38, 43] 形成鲜明反差——DocVQA 包含大量涉及表格的问题。

  • 5.

    When tasked with tracing colored paths in a simplified subway map of only 2 to 8 paths and a total of 4 stations, VLMs often fail to count the paths between two stations, i.e., with an accuracy of ∼\sim31% to 58% (Sec. 4.6).

    • 5. 在仅有 2 至 8 条线路、共 4 个车站的简化地铁图里追踪彩色线路时，VLM 常常数错两站之间的线路数，准确率仅为 ∼\sim31% 到 58%（第 4.6 节）。

  • 6.

    GPT-4o is better than Gemini-1.5 Pro on 7 existing complex VLM benchmarks [38, 43] but worse on BlindTest. On average across all 7 tasks, VLMs perform at 58.07% accuracy with Sonnet-3.5 being the best (77.84% accuracy), which is still far lower than the expected 100% accuracy of humans (see Tab. 1). In sum, BlindTest reveals some remarkable VLM limitations that are not measured in prior benchmarks.

    • 6. GPT-4o 在 7 个现有复杂 VLM 基准上优于 Gemini-1.5 Pro [38, 43]，在 BlindTest 上却更差。在全部 7 项任务上平均，VLM 的准确率为 58.07%，Sonnet-3.5 最好（77.84% 准确率），仍远低于人类预期的 100%（见表 1）。总之，BlindTest 揭示出一些此前的基准未能度量的、颇为显著的 VLM 局限。

  • 7.

    The SOTA “slow-thinking” VLMs are at best on par with the regular VLMs on BlindTest (71.59% vs. 72.75%; Sec. 4.7), i.e., longer inference is not immediately addressing the low-level visual challenge posed by BlindTest.

    • 7. 在 BlindTest 上，当前最优的「慢思考」VLM 至多与常规 VLM 持平（71.59% 对 72.75%；第 4.7 节），即更长的推理并不能立刻解决 BlindTest 提出的低层视觉挑战。

  • 8.

    Most VLMs perform better (with some reaching ∼\sim100% accuracy) on simplified versions of BlindTest (Sec. 5) where we increasingly add more space between letters (Sec. 5.1) or between shapes (Sec. 5.2), and gradually reduce the number of turns in subway maps (Sec. 5.3). For instance, LLaVA-OneV-72B-ov and Sonnet-3’s accuracy is increased by +20 and +63 on the circled-letter task and counting overlapping circles, respectively, when the images are simplified.

    • 8. 在 BlindTest 的简化版本中（第 5 节），多数 VLM 表现更好（部分达到 ∼\sim100% 准确率）——我们逐步增加字母之间（第 5.1 节）或形状之间（第 5.2 节）的间距，并逐步减少地铁图中的转折数（第 5.3 节）。例如，当图像被简化后，LLaVA-OneV-72B-ov 与 Sonnet-3 在被圈字母任务与清点重叠圆任务上的准确率分别提升了 +20 与 +63。

  • 9.

    Linear-probing the features of the vision encoders before and after the projection layer in the smallest open-source VLMs (LLaVA-OneV-S and Phi-3.5) shows that these vision encoders already contain sufficient information to solve the two-circle and counting the intersections in the line chart tasks with ≥\geq99.47% accuracy (Sec. 6). That is, the challenge lies in decoding the visual information into the correct language outputs.

    • 9. 对最小的开源 VLM（LLaVA-OneV-S 与 Phi-3.5）在投影层前后的视觉编码器特征做线性探测显示，这些视觉编码器已包含足以解决两圆 与折线图交点计数 任务的信息，准确率达 ≥\geq99.47%（第 6 节）。也就是说，挑战在于把视觉信息解码为正确的语言输出。

    图 1：VLM 在 BlindTest 的简单任务上失败。

    2 Vision language models

    2 视觉语言模型

    Our goal is to evaluate how SOTA VLMs perceive simple images composed of interacting geometric primitives.

    我们的目标是评估当前最优的 VLM 如何感知由相互作用的几何图元构成的简单图像。

    4 commercial   We test four SOTA models: GPT-4o ( ), Gemini-1.5 Pro (  Gemini-1.5), Claude-3 Sonnet (  Sonnet-3), and Claude-3.5 Sonnet (  Sonnet-3.5) that are ranking highest on 7 recent vision-language benchmarks (see [38] and Table 10 in [43]), which cover multi-discipline, college-level subjects in MMMU [57], science diagrams in AI2D [18], mathematics in MathVista [27], charts in ChartQA [30], documents in DocVQA [31], and videos in ActivityNet-QA [56] & EgoSchema [28]. We initially run experiments with Claude 3 Opus [3] but swap it with Sonnet-3.5, which performs more accurately on BlindTest and costs 5×\times less. All models tested are described in App. 0.A.

    4 款商用模型：我们测试四款 SOTA 模型：GPT-4o（ ）、Gemini-1.5 Pro（ Gemini-1.5）、Claude-3 Sonnet（ Sonnet-3）与 Claude-3.5 Sonnet（ Sonnet-3.5），它们在 7 个近期视觉语言基准上排名最高（见 [38] 与 [43] 中的表 10），涵盖 MMMU [57] 的多学科大学水平科目、AI2D [18] 的科学示意图、MathVista [27] 的数学、ChartQA [30] 的图表、DocVQA [31] 的文档，以及 ActivityNet-QA [56] 与 EgoSchema [28] 的视频。我们最初用 Claude 3 Opus [3] 做实验，后换成 Sonnet-3.5——后者在 BlindTest 上更准确，且成本仅为其 5×\times 分之一。所有受测模型的说明见附录 0.A。

    8 open-source   For completeness, we also test 8 open-source models of varying sizes (from 0.5B to 72B parameters) across three different families: LLaVA OneVision-qwen2 ( LLaVA-OneV) [20], Phi-3.5-vision-instruct ( Phi-3.5) [1], and InternVL-2 [7]. Yet, they underperform the four closed-source models described above (see results in App. 0.C).

    8 款开源模型：为完备起见，我们还测试了 8 款不同规模（参数量从 0.5B 到 72B）、分属三个系列的开源模型：LLaVA OneVision-qwen2（ LLaVA-OneV）[20]、Phi-3.5-vision-instruct（ Phi-3.5）[1] 与 InternVL-2 [7]。不过它们的表现不及上述四款闭源模型（结果见附录 0.C）。

    2 slow-thinking   Given that BlindTest intuitively does not require slow, iterative thinking, our main goal is to evaluate standard VLMs (e.g., GPT-4o instead of GPT-o1). However, for completeness, we also test two slow-thinking models [17]: A closed-source Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking and an open-source QVQ-Preview (QVQ) [51, 48] (Sec. 4.7). However, these models generally do not outperform standard ones on BlindTest, supporting our hypothesis that BlindTest is a low-level visual task that does not require high-level reasoning.

    2 款慢思考模型：鉴于 BlindTest 直观上并不需要缓慢、迭代式的思考，我们的主要目标是评估标准 VLM（例如 GPT-4o 而非 GPT-o1）。不过为完备起见，我们也测试了两款慢思考模型 [17]：闭源的 Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking 与开源的 QVQ-Preview（QVQ）[51, 48]（第 4.7 节）。然而，这些模型在 BlindTest 上总体并未超过标准模型，支持了我们的假设：BlindTest 是一项不需要高层推理的低层视觉任务。

    3 BlindTest benchmark of 7 tasks

    3 含 7 项任务的 BlindTest 基准

    Eye exams   Like humans’ visual acuity tests [5], we design a set of 7 very simple, yet novel tasks that are composed of common geometric primitives. We do not use the existing tests designed for human-eye exams for two reasons. First, we avoid using the questions that exist on the Internet, which may provide an inflated measure of vision capabilities [55, 6, 13]. Second, our preliminary experiments show that GPT-4o already performs very well on humans’ eye exams, which typically contain single, separate symbols—e.g., the Snellen chart [5], tumbling E [5], and contrast sensitivity charts [29, 15].
    Motivation   Our BlindTest benchmark tests VLMs on identifying known geometric primitives when they are close together, overlapping, or intersecting. We hypothesize that VLMs will struggle because they mostly rely on “late fusion” [25, 47], i.e., first extracting visual representations without considering the textual question, and then feeding them to a large language model (LLM) for processing. Therefore, while geometric primitives in BlindTest are well known, their exact spatial information on a white canvas (e.g., the size and position of a ○ ) is typically not describable in natural language, even for humans, and may not be captured by the vision encoders trained mostly on natural images.
    Controls   For each test image, we prompt VLMs using two different, yet semantically equivalent questions. Furthermore, we test VLMs on multiple versions of each task across three different image sizes (Secs. 3.1, 3.2, 3.4, 3.6 and 3.7) and two to three line thickness values (Secs. 3.1, 3.5, 3.4, 3.6 and 3.7).

    视力检查：如同人类的视敏度测试 [5]，我们设计了一组 7 项非常简单却新颖的任务，它们由常见的几何图元构成。我们没有采用为人类视力检查设计的现成测试，原因有二。第一，我们避免使用互联网上已有的题目，因为那可能给出被抬高的视觉能力度量 [55, 6, 13]。第二，我们的初步实验显示，GPT-4o 在人类视力检查上的表现已经很好，而这类检查通常只含单个、彼此分离的符号——例如斯内伦视力表 [5]、翻滚 E 字表 [5] 与对比敏感度图 [29, 15]。动机：我们的 BlindTest 基准检验 VLM 在几何图元彼此靠近、重叠或相交时识别它们的能力。我们假设 VLM 会表现吃力，因为它们大多依赖「后期融合」[25, 47]，即先在不考虑文本问题的情况下提取视觉表征，再将其送入大语言模型（LLM）处理。因此，尽管 BlindTest 中的几何图元广为人知，它们在白色画布上的精确空间信息（例如一个 ○ 的大小与位置）通常无法用自然语言描述——即便对人类也是如此——也可能未被主要用自然图像训练的视觉编码器所捕捉。控制项：对每张测试图像，我们用两种措辞不同但语义等价的问题提示 VLM。此外，我们在三种不同图像尺寸（第 3.1、3.2、3.4、3.6 与 3.7 节）与两到三种线条粗细取值（第 3.1、3.5、3.4、3.6 与 3.7 节）下，对每项任务的多个版本测试 VLM。

    3.1 Task 1: Counting line intersections

    3.1 任务 1：数直线交点

    Given the impressive accuracy of VLMs on answering questions on diagrams and charts (e.g., Sonnet-3.5 scoring 94.7% on AI2D and 90.8% on ChartQA) [2], a reasonable hypothesis is that VLMs must be able to see if two graphs intersect in a chart. Here, we test this hypothesis by asking VLMs to count the number of intersections (0, 1 or 2) between two 2-segment piece-wise linear functions.

    鉴于 VLM 在回答示意图与图表问题上的准确率令人印象深刻（例如 Sonnet-3.5 在 AI2D 上得 94.7%、在 ChartQA 上得 90.8%）[2]，一个合理的假设是：VLM 必定能看出图表中两条曲线是否相交。这里我们通过让 VLM 数两条两段分段线性函数之间交点（0、1 或 2）的个数来检验这一假设。

    Images   We create 1,800 images (Fig. F21) of 2D line plots drawn on an image of size of C×CC\times C, where C∈{384,768,1152}C\in\{384,768,1152\}. Each line plot consists of two line segments, defined by three points whose x-coordinates are fixed at {0,C2,C}\{0,\frac{C}{2},C\}px (see Fig. F21). The y-coordinates are randomly sampled from a pre-defined, invisible 12×\times12 grid to ensure there is sufficient spacing between two plots and that there are exactly 0, 1 or 2 intersections. See Sec. 0.H.1 for more details.

    图像：我们生成 1,800 张二维折线图（图 F21），绘制在尺寸为 C×CC\times C 的图像上，其中 C∈{384,768,1152}C\in\{384,768,1152\}。每张折线图由两条线段构成，由 x 坐标固定为 {0,C2,C}\{0,\frac{C}{2},C\}px 的三个点定义（见图 F21）。y 坐标从一个预定义的、不可见的 12×\times12 网格中随机采样，以保证两张图之间有足够的间距，且恰好存在 0、1 或 2 个交点。详见第 0.H.1 节。

    3.2 Task 2: Two circles

    3.2 任务 2：两个圆

    In the task of counting line intersections (Sec. 3.1), each image contains two long, thin colored lines on a large white canvas. Here, we test models in a complementary setting where the two interacting objects (here, two same-sized filled circles ) are larger while their gap is smaller. This task evaluates VLM ability in detecting (1) a small gap between two circles; and (2) that two circles are overlapping, i.e., no gaps. We vary circle and gap sizes and ask VLMs if two circles are (a) overlapping or (b) touching each other.

    在数直线交点的任务（第 3.1 节）中，每张图在大幅白色画布上包含两条细长的彩色线。这里我们在互补的设定下测试模型：两个相互作用的物体（此处为两个等大的实心圆 ）更大，而它们之间的间隙更小。该任务考察 VLM 检测（1）两圆之间细小间隙；（2）两圆重叠（即无间隙）的能力。我们改变圆与间隙的大小，询问 VLM 两圆是（a）重叠还是（b）相切。

    Images   Given a blank image of size C×CC\times C, we draw two same-sized circles of diameter ϕ∈{C4,C5,C6,C7}\phi\in\{\frac{C}{4},\frac{C}{5},\frac{C}{6},\frac{C}{7}\} with a boundary-to-boundary distance =ϕ×d=\phi\times d where d∈d\in {-0.25, -0.2, -0.15, -0.1, -0.05, 0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.45, 0.5} to cover all three cases: overlapping, tangent, and disjoint (see Fig. F4a). The two circles are arranged in four different orientations, making a 90∘90^{\circ}, 0∘0^{\circ}, −45∘-45^{\circ}, and 45∘45^{\circ} angle with the x-axis (Fig. F4b). The whole grid sampling generates 224 images per image size. We replicate the procedure for 3 image sizes, i.e., C=384,769,1155C=384,769,1155 px to create a total of 3×\times224 = 768 images. See Sec. 0.F.1 for more details.

    图像：给定一张尺寸为 C×CC\times C 的空白图像，我们绘制两个直径为 ϕ∈{C4,C5,C6,C7}\phi\in\{\frac{C}{4},\frac{C}{5},\frac{C}{6},\frac{C}{7}\} 的等大圆，边界到边界的距离为 =ϕ×d=\phi\times d，其中 d∈d\in 取自 {-0.25, -0.2, -0.15, -0.1, -0.05, 0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.45, 0.5}，以覆盖重叠、相切与分离三种情形（见图 F4a）。两个圆按四种不同朝向排列，与 x 轴分别成 90∘90^{\circ}、0∘0^{\circ}、−45∘-45^{\circ} 与 45∘45^{\circ} 角（图 F4b）。整套网格采样对每种图像尺寸生成 224 张图像。我们对 3 种图像尺寸（即 C=384,769,1155C=384,769,1155 px）重复该流程，共生成 3×\times224 = 768 张图像。详见第 0.F.1 节。

    3.3 Task 3: The circled letter

    3.3 任务 3：被圈住的字母

    Consistent with prior reports [54, 53, 44], we find that VLMs can 100% accurately identify a primitive shape (e.g., a red circle ) [44] and can perfectly read an English word (e.g., Subdermatoglyphic ) alone. Here, we superimpose the red circle on every letter, one at a time, in the word, and ask VLMs to identify which letter is being circled. While the task is easy to humans, our hypothesis is that if a VLM’s vision is “blurry”, it might not be able to identify the exact letter being circled since there is tiny spacing between the adjacent letters.

    与此前报告一致 [54, 53, 44]，我们发现 VLM 能 100% 准确地识别一个图元形状（例如红色圆圈 ）[44]，也能完美读出单独呈现的英文单词（例如 Subdermatoglyphic ）。这里，我们把红圈逐个叠加到单词的每个字母上，并要求 VLM 辨认被圈住的是哪个字母。虽然该任务对人类轻而易举，我们的假设是：若 VLM 的视觉是「模糊」的，它可能无法识别被圈住的究竟是哪个字母，因为相邻字母之间的间距极小。

    Images   We choose three strings Acknowledgement , Subdermatoglyphic , and
    tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM because they contain characters of variable widths and heights. Furthermore, all four tested VLMs can read out all characters in these strings when they are input to the models as an image. While Acknowledgement is a common English word, Subdermatoglyphic is the longest word without repetitive letters. We also test VLMs on the random string tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM to estimate how much model accuracy is due to its familiarity with the word.

    图像：我们选取三个字符串 Acknowledgement 、 Subdermatoglyphic 与 tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM ，因为它们包含宽度与高度各异的字符。此外，当这些字符串以图像形式输入时，四款受测 VLM 都能读出其中的所有字符。Acknowledgement 是常见英文单词，Subdermatoglyphic 则是不含重复字母的最长单词。我们还用随机字符串 tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM 测试 VLM，以估计模型准确率中有多少来自对该单词的熟悉度。

    For each (string, circled-letter) pair, we render a 512×\times512 image by choosing among 3 red oval line-thickness levels, 2 font families, and 4 different values of image padding for a total of 24 images. That is, we generate 360, 408, and 480 images for Acknowledgement (15 letters), Subdermatoglyphic (17 letters), and tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM (20 letters), respectively. We ensure each letter to be circled fits completely the oval  (see Fig. F10). See Sec. 0.G.1 for more details.

    对每个（字符串，被圈字母）组合，我们从 3 档红色椭圆线条粗细、2 种字体族与 4 种不同图像留白取值中选取，渲染出一张 512×\times512 图像，共 24 张。也就是说，我们分别为 Acknowledgement （15 个字母）、 Subdermatoglyphic （17 个字母）与 tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM （20 个字母）生成 360、408 与 480 张图像。我们确保每个待圈字母都完整容纳于椭圆 之内（见图 F10）。详见第 0.G.1 节。

    3.4 Task 4: Counting overlapping shapes ○   ○   ○

    3.4 任务 4：清点重叠的形状 ○ ○ ○

    Aligned with prior research [54], we also find VLMs to be able to count disjoint circles ( ○ ○ ○ ). Yet, here, we test VLMs on counting circles that are intersecting ( ○   ○   ○ ) like in the Olympic logo—a common cognitive development exercise for preschoolers [45, 37]. Our hypothesis is that a “blurry” vision may not see the intersection between two circles clearly and therefore unable to trace circles and count them. For generalization of our findings, we repeat the experiment with pentagons ( ⬠ ) as well (instead of circles).

    与此前研究一致 [54]，我们也发现 VLM 能够清点彼此分离的圆（ ○ ○ ○ ）。然而在这里，我们测试 VLM 清点相交圆（ ○ ○ ○ ）的能力——如同奥运标志那样，这也是学龄前儿童常见的认知发展练习 [45, 37]。我们的假设是：「模糊」的视觉可能看不清两个圆之间的相交处，因而无法追踪圆并清点它们。为检验结论的泛化性，我们也用五边形（ ⬠ ）重复了该实验（取代圆形）。

    Images   In an image of size C×CC\times C, where C∈{384,769,1155}C\in\{384,769,1155\}px. We draw N∈{5,6,7,8,9}N\in\{5,6,7,8,9\} overlapping, same-sized circles arranged in two rows like the Olympic logo (see Fig. F30). A circle diameter ϕ∈{C7,C10}\phi\in\{\frac{C}{7},\frac{C}{10}\}. We repeat the images with two different line thicknesses for rendering circles. This procedure renders 3 resolutions ×\times 5 values of NN ×\times 2 diameters ×\times 2 line widths ×\times 2 color options = 120 images. We also vertically flip all 120 images, resulting in a total of 240 images. We repeat for pentagons ( ⬠ ) in addition to circles ( ○ ), resulting in 240×\times2 shapes = 480 images in total. For pentagons, their side length d∈{C7,C10}d\in\{\frac{C}{7},\frac{C}{10}\}. See Sec. 0.J.1 for more details.

    图像：在尺寸为 C×CC\times C 的图像中，其中 C∈{384,769,1155}C\in\{384,769,1155\}px。我们绘制 N∈{5,6,7,8,9}N\in\{5,6,7,8,9\} 个相互重叠、等大的圆，像奥运标志那样排成两行（见图 F30）。圆的直径为 ϕ∈{C7,C10}\phi\in\{\frac{C}{7},\frac{C}{10}\}。我们用两种不同的线条粗细渲染圆，重复生成图像。该流程产出 3 种分辨率 ×\times、NN 的 5 个取值 ×\times、2 种直径 ×\times、2 种线宽 ×\times、2 种配色选项，共 120 张图像。我们又把这 120 张图像全部垂直翻转，得到 240 张。对五边形（ ⬠ ）与圆形（ ○ ）各重复一遍，共 240×\times2 种形状 = 480 张图像。五边形的边长为 d∈{C7,C10}d\in\{\frac{C}{7},\frac{C}{10}\}。详见第 0.J.1 节。

    3.5 Task 5: Counting the nested squares

    3.5 任务 5：清点嵌套的正方形

    In addition to testing VLMs on counting the intersecting circles (Sec. 3.4), here, we test a complementary setting by arranging the shapes so that their edges do not intersect. That is, each shape is nested entirely inside another (see Fig. F26). For completeness, we test squares ( □\Box ) in this task.

    除测试 VLM 清点相交圆（第 3.4 节）之外，这里我们通过让形状彼此不产生边相交来测试互补的设定，即每个形状完整嵌套在另一个形状内部（见图 F26）。为完备起见，本任务中我们测试正方形（ □\Box ）。

    Images   In an image of size 1000×\times1000px, we render N∈{2,3,4,5}N\in\{2,3,4,5\} nested squares one at a time from the largest to the smallest. First, the outermost square is rendered using a random edge length dd. And each subsequent smaller square is placed randomly inside the previous one and has an edge length of 75% of that of the outer square. We render squares using a line width of {3,4,6}\{3,4,6\}px and ensure no squares touch by edges. For each line width, we generate 10 images (where squares have different, random locations) to create 3 ×\times 10 = 30 images. Repeating the process for all NN values results in 4 ×\times 30 = 120 images. See Sec. 0.I.1 for more details.

    图像：在 1000×\times1000px 的图像中，我们一次渲染 N∈{2,3,4,5}N\in\{2,3,4,5\} 个嵌套正方形，由大到小。首先，用随机边长 dd 渲染最外层的正方形；随后每个更小的正方形被随机放置在前一个之内，边长为外层正方形的 75%。我们用 {3,4,6}\{3,4,6\}px 的线宽渲染正方形，并确保正方形之间不因边缘而接触。对每种线宽，我们生成 10 张图像（正方形位置各不相同且随机），得到 3 ×\times 10 = 30 张图像。对所有 NN 取值重复该流程，得到 4 ×\times 30 = 120 张图像。详见第 0.I.1 节。

    3.6 Task 6: Counting the rows and columns of a grid

    3.6 任务 6：数网格的行数与列数

    The results from prior tasks show VLMs cannot always count shapes that are overlapping (Sec. 3.4) or nested (Sec. 3.5). What about adjacent shapes □\Box □\Box ? Here, we tile up shapes (specifically, □\Box ) into a grid and challenge VLMs to count—a task that is supposedly simple to VLMs given their remarkable performance (≥\geq 90% accuracy) [38, 43] on DocVQA [31], which includes many questions with tables. To simplify the task, we ask models to count the number of rows and columns in a given table (either empty or text-containing).

    先前任务的结果表明，VLM 并不总能清点相互重叠（第 3.4 节）或嵌套（第 3.5 节）的形状。那么相邻的形状 □\Box □\Box 又如何？这里我们把形状（具体地，□\Box ）平铺成网格，并要求 VLM 清点——鉴于 VLM 在 DocVQA [31] 上的出色表现（≥\geq 90% 准确率）[38, 43]，而该基准包含大量涉及表格的问题，这理应是一项对 VLM 而言简单的任务。为简化任务，我们让模型数出给定表格的行数与列数（表格可为空或含文字）。

    Images   A grid may have NN×\timesNN, NN×\timesN′N^{\prime}, or N′N^{\prime}×\timesNN cells, where N∈{3,4,5,6,7,8,9}N\in\{3,4,5,6,7,8,\\ 9\} and N′=N+1N^{\prime}=N+1. We also include grids of size 10×\times10 to balance the benchmark with the row and column sizes. Each grid is rendered with two different line widths on a canvas of size C×CC\times C where C∈{500,1250,2000}C\in\{500,1250,2000\}px. Besides empty grids, we also replicate the procedure to make grids contain text (which is more common in real-world tables) where each cell contains a single random English word (see Fig. F36). Both versions (empty and text-containing) combined have 2×\times132 = 264 images. See Sec. 0.K.1 for more details.

    图像：一个网格可以有 NN×\timesNN、NN×\timesN′N^{\prime} 或 N′N^{\prime}×\timesNN 个单元格，其中 N∈{3,4,5,6,7,8,9}N\in\{3,4,5,6,7,8,\\ 9\} 且 N′=N+1N^{\prime}=N+1。我们还纳入 10×\times10 的网格，以使基准在行、列规模上保持均衡。每个网格以两种线宽渲染在尺寸为 C×CC\times C 的画布上，其中 C∈{500,1250,2000}C\in\{500,1250,2000\}px。除空网格外，我们也复制该流程生成含文字的网格（这在真实表格中更常见），每个单元格含一个随机英文单词（见图 F36）。两个版本（空网格与含文字网格）合计 2×\times132 = 264 张图像。详见第 0.K.1 节。

    3.7 Task 7: Following single-colored paths

    3.7 任务 7：追踪单色路径

    It is important for VLMs to be able to follow paths in order to read maps or charts [30], interpret graphs [19], and user annotations (e.g., arrows) in input images [54]. To assess path-following capability, this task asks models to count the unique-color paths between two given stations in a simplified subway map.

    对 VLM 而言，能够追踪路径是读取地图或图表 [30]、理解图结构 [19]，以及理解输入图像中用户标注（例如箭头）[54] 的重要前提。为评估路径追踪能力，本任务要求模型数出简化地铁图中两个给定站点之间单色路径的条数。

    Images   We create each subway map on an image of size C×CC\times C, where C∈{512,1024}C\in\{512,1024\}px (see Fig. F41). We write 4 station names (A, B, C, D) at 4 fixed coordinates ∈{(C2,C),(C,C2),(C2,0),(0,C2)}\in\{(\frac{C}{2},C),(C,\frac{C}{2}),(\frac{C}{2},0),(0,\frac{C}{2})\}, respectively. We divide the canvas into an invisible grid of 18×\times18 cells and initialize 3 path-starting points C18\frac{C}{18}px away from each station. We draw a path, using the depth-first search algorithm starting from a random station and a random starting point, where a valid move is one cell in any direction: North, south, east or west. We repeat the process so that each station has exactly N∈{1,2,3}N\in\{1,2,3\} outgoing paths, for a total of 180 maps. See Sec. 0.L.1 for details.

    图像：我们在尺寸为 C×CC\times C 的图像上生成每张地铁图，其中 C∈{512,1024}C\in\{512,1024\}px（见图 F41）。我们把 4 个站名（A、B、C、D）分别写在 4 个固定坐标 ∈{(C2,C),(C,C2),(C2,0),(0,C2)}\in\{(\frac{C}{2},C),(C,\frac{C}{2}),(\frac{C}{2},0),(0,\frac{C}{2})\} 处。我们把画布划分为 18×\times18 的不可见网格，并在距每个车站 C18\frac{C}{18}px 处初始化 3 个路径起点。我们采用深度优先搜索算法，从一个随机车站与一个随机起点出发绘制路径，其中一次合法移动是朝北、南、东、西任一方向移动一格。我们重复该流程，使每个车站恰好有 N∈{1,2,3}N\in\{1,2,3\} 条出边，共得到 180 张地图。详见第 0.L.1 节。

    4 Results

    4 结果

    表 1：四款 VLM 在 7 项 BlindTest 任务上的平均准确率为 58.07%，显著高于随机猜测（24%）；后者把每项任务视为一个单标签的 NN 类分类问题计算得出。Sonnet-3.5 最好（77.84%），但仍远未达到预期的 100% 准确率。需注意，最好的开源 VLM（表 T1）仅与之持平，而最好的慢思考 VLM 略逊于 （第 4.7 节）。

    4.1 VLMs cannot reliably count line intersections

    4.1 VLM 无法可靠地数清直线交点

    Experiment   We parse every model’s response to extract the final answer and then compare it to the groundtruth. We report the mean accuracy of every model on two prompts and analyze how accuracy changes as we vary hyperparameters (e.g., line widths and image sizes).

    实验：我们解析每个模型的回答以抽取最终答案，再与真值比较。我们报告每个模型在两种提示下的平均准确率，并分析准确率随超参数（例如线宽与图像尺寸）变化的情况。

    Line width            
    0.005×C0.005\times C   45.00   67.55   45.22   75.83
    0.010×C0.010\times C   38.22   66.33   41.61   74.88
    Mean   41.61   66.94   43.41   75.36

    表 2：按线宽（单位为像素，其中 CC = 图像宽度）细分的准确率，对两种提示取平均，显示 VLM 无法可靠地数清两条简单二维折线之间的交点。

    图 2：折线图图像被划分为 12×\times12 网格后，x 轴表示两条两段折线在三对点上的平均距离（以网格单元计）。当两张折线图靠得更近时（左），VLM 往往比它们相距较远时（右）更容易混淆。

    Results   First, across two prompts and two line widths, all VLMs are 56.84% accurate (Tab. 1a), far from the expected 100% accuracy on this easy task (Fig. F24). The best accuracy is only 75.36% (Sonnet-3.5) (Tab. 2). Specifically, VLMs tend to perform worse when the distance between two plots narrows (Fig. 2). As each line plot is composed of three key points, the distance between two plots is computed as the mean distance over three corresponding point pairs. See Figs. 1 and 0.H.4 for more samples of VLM predictions. VLMs perform similarly across three image sizes (Sec. 0.H.2).

    结果：首先，在两种提示与两种线宽下，所有 VLM 的准确率为 56.84%（表 1a），远未达到这项简单任务上预期的 100%（图 F24）。最好的准确率仅为 75.36%（Sonnet-3.5）（表 2）。具体地，当两张折线图之间的距离变小时，VLM 的表现往往更差（图 2）。由于每条折线由三个关键点构成，两张折线图之间的距离取三对对应点距离的平均值。更多 VLM 预测样例见图 1 与图 0.H.4。VLM 在三种图像尺寸上表现相近（第 0.H.2 节）。

    Our findings are in stark contrast to the high accuracy of VLMs on ChartQA [43, 38], suggesting that VLMs can recognize the overall trend of a line plot but unable to “zoom in” to extract details, e.g., seeing which lines are intersecting.

    我们的发现与 VLM 在 ChartQA [43, 38] 上的高准确率形成鲜明反差，提示 VLM 能识别折线图的整体趋势，却无法「放大」以提取细节，例如看清哪些线在相交。

    4.2 VLMs cannot clearly see if two circles overlap or not

    4.2 VLM 无法看清两个圆是否重叠

    Motivated by VLM poor performance in counting line intersections (Sec. 4.1), here, we replace lines by large, filled circles and ask VLMs explicitly if the two circles are touching (or overlapping).

    受 VLM 在数直线交点上表现不佳（第 4.1 节）的启发，这里我们把直线换成大的实心圆，并明确询问 VLM 两个圆是相切还是重叠。

    Experiment   Since we instruct VLMs to output a binary answer (Yes/No), we use Python to extract VLMs’ formatted answer from their responses for comparing with groundtruth.

    实验：由于我们指示 VLM 输出二元答案（是/否），我们用 Python 从回答中抽取 VLM 的格式化答案，以便与真值比较。

    Results   Surprisingly, even on this task where objects ( ) are large and clearly visible to humans, no VLMs are able to solve it perfectly—their mean accuracy is 86.70% (Tab. 1b). The best accuracy is 93.62% (Gemini-1.5) over all images and two prompts (Tab. 3). A common trend is when two circles are closer together, VLMs tend to perform more poorly, making educated guesses, e.g., Sonnet-3.5 often answers “No” conservatively (Fig. F8). GPT-4o performs the worst and shockingly is not 100% accurate even when the distance between two circles is as large as one radius (Fig. 3; d=0.5d=0.5). That is, consistent with the results from Sec. 4.1, VLMs seem to be unable to always detect the gap or intersection between two filled circles (Figs. 1 and F8).

    结果：令人意外的是，即便在这项物体（ ）大且对人类清晰可见的任务上，也没有任何 VLM 能完美解决——它们的平均准确率为 86.70%（表 1b）。在所有图像与两种提示上，最好的准确率为 93.62%（Gemini-1.5）（表 3）。一个共同趋势是：当两个圆靠得更近时，VLM 的表现往往更差，做出经验性猜测——例如 Sonnet-3.5 常常保守地回答「否」（图 F8）。GPT-4o 表现最差，且令人震惊的是，即便两圆间距已大到一个半径，它仍达不到 100% 准确（图 3；d=0.5d=0.5）。也就是说，与第 4.1 节的结果一致，VLM 似乎并不总能检测出两个实心圆之间的间隙或相交（图 1 与图 F8）。

    Model   Overlapping   Touching   Mean
    GPT-4o   74.74   77.08   75.91
    Gemini-1.5   94.01   93.23   93.62
    Sonnet-3   89.58   83.33   86.46
    Sonnet-3.5   86.46   95.18   90.82

    表 3： 与 在两种不同提示（「重叠」与「相切」）下比 与 表现更为一致。

    图 3：当两个圆相切（d=0.0d=0.0）或靠得很近（d=0.05,0.1d=0.05,0.1）时，VLM 表现很差。然而， 在 d≥0.0d\geq 0.0 上更好（或许是因为它倾向于回答「否」）。

    An explanation is that due to the late-fusion mechanism [47], VLMs extract visual features from the image before even looking at the question, causing this “blindness”. In contrast, if a model first knows that the question asks it to focus on the area between the two circles, it then might be able to extract accurate visual information to answer such simple questions.

    一种解释是：由于后期融合机制 [47]，VLM 在看问题之前就已从图像中提取视觉特征，从而造成了这种「失明」。相反，如果模型先知道问题要求它聚焦于两圆之间的区域，它就可能提取出准确的视觉信息来回答这类简单问题。

    While VLMs perform similarly across three image resolutions (Sec. 0.F.2), every model performs the best at a specific circle orientation (Sec. 0.F.5). Moreover, VLMs’ performance does not change substantially (±5.79\pm 5.79 points for Sonnet-3.5 and ±\pm10.81 for GPT-4o) when tested against different colors (Sec. 0.F.6), ruling out the impact of color on their performance on the task. More examples of VLMs’ answers are in Sec. 0.F.8.

    虽然 VLM 在三种图像分辨率上表现相近（第 0.F.2 节），但每个模型都在某个特定的圆朝向上表现最好（第 0.F.5 节）。此外，当用不同颜色测试时，VLM 的表现没有实质变化（对 Sonnet-3.5 为 ±5.79\pm 5.79 个点，对 GPT-4o 为 ±\pm10.81）（第 0.F.6 节），排除了颜色对该任务表现的影响。更多 VLM 回答样例见第 0.F.8 节。

    4.3 VLMs do not always see the letter inside the red circle

    4.3 VLM 并不总能看见红圈内的字母

    Experiment   To evaluate the models’ ability to recognize individual characters in an image, we place a red circle over one character in a word. We prompt VLMs to put their prediction in {curly braces} and then we compare the lowercase version of this character to the lowercase version of the groundtruth character.

    实验：为评估模型识别图像中单个字符的能力，我们把一个红圈覆盖在单词的某个字符上。我们提示 VLM 把预测结果放在 {花括号} 中，然后把该字符的小写形式与真值字符的小写形式作比较。

    图 4：对 VLM 而言，辨认被圈住的字母并非易事，无论是对两个英文单词（ Acknowledgement 与 Subdermatoglyphic ）还是对一个随机字符串（ tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM ）。出错时，VLM 倾向于预测被圈字母的相邻字母。

    Results   All VLMs can accurately spell out the string when there is a red oval  superimposed on the image. Yet, interestingly, reading out which letter is being circled turns out to be a challenge (mean model accuracy: 79.7%; Tab. 1c).

    结果：当没有红色椭圆 叠加在图像上时，所有 VLM 都能准确拼出字符串。然而有意思的是，读出哪个字母被圈住却成了一项挑战（模型平均准确率：79.7%；表 1c）。

    When the letters are close together, VLMs often predict letters adjacent to the one being circled (see the confusion matrix in Fig. F13 and more results in Figs. 1 and 0.G.2). Sometimes models hallucinate, e.g., coming up with characters non-existent in Subdermatoglyphic (e.g., “9”, “n”, “©”) despite having the ability to accurately spell out the word (see Fig. F13). We also observe that VLMs, on average, fail to see the circled letter across various common English words (mean accuracy is 86.43% in Sec. 0.G.6). However, as the words get shorter in length and there is no repetitive letters in them, VLMs tend to perform better. More failure cases are reported in Secs. 0.G.3 and 0.G.8.

    当字母彼此靠近时，VLM 常常预测被圈字母的相邻字母（见图 F13 的混淆矩阵，以及图 1 与图 0.G.2 中的更多结果）。有时模型会产生幻觉，例如凭空造出 Subdermatoglyphic 中不存在的字符（如「9」「n」「©」），尽管它们有能力准确拼出该单词（见图 F13）。我们还观察到，VLM 在各种常见英文单词上平均也无法看清被圈的字母（第 0.G.6 节中平均准确率为 86.43%）。不过，随着单词变短且不含重复字母，VLM 的表现往往更好。更多失败案例见第 0.G.3 与 0.G.8 节。

    On average, models perform better (+0.46 to +13 points) on the two English words compared to the random string (Tab. T8), suggesting that familiarity with the word help VLMs make better educated guesses, slightly improving accuracy.

    平均而言，模型在两个英文单词上的表现优于随机字符串（+0.46 至 +13 个点）（表 T8），说明对单词的熟悉有助于 VLM 做出更好的经验性猜测，略微提升准确率。

    Sonnet-3.5 and Gemini-1.5 are the top-2 models (87.88% and 83.29%) and are better than GPT-4o and Sonnet-3 by a large margin of nearly +15 points (Tab. T8). VLMs perform similarly across two prompts (Sec. 0.G.5) and two font families (Sec. 0.G.4). See also Fig. F1 for an example of GPT-4o and Gemini-1.5 making educated guesses on the color of the overlapping area between two overlapping circles (Task 2).

    Sonnet-3.5 与 Gemini-1.5 是前两名（87.88% 与 83.29%），并以近 +15 个点的较大幅度优于 GPT-4o 与 Sonnet-3（表 T8）。VLM 在两种提示（第 0.G.5 节）与两种字体族（第 0.G.4 节）下表现相近。另见图 F1 中 GPT-4o 与 Gemini-1.5 对两个重叠圆之间重叠区域颜色做出经验性猜测的例子（任务 2）。

    4.4 VLMs struggle to count overlapped and nested shapes

    4.4 VLM 难以清点重叠与嵌套的形状

    Experiment   We run all VLMs on images of overlapping shapes ( ○ and ⬠ ) (Sec. 3.4) and nested squares (Sec. 3.5). We prompt VLMs to output the predicted number of shapes in a formatted answer (which is extracted and compared with groundtruth). For each shape ( ○ , ⬠ or □\Box ), we run two different prompts.

    实验：我们在重叠形状（ ○ 与 ⬠ ）（第 3.4 节）与嵌套正方形（第 3.5 节）的图像上运行所有 VLM。我们提示 VLM 以格式化答案输出预测的形状数量（随后抽取并与真值比较）。对每种形状（ ○ 、 ⬠ 或 □\Box ），我们运行两种不同的提示。

    Results   On counting overlapping circles, pentagons, and nested squares, VLM mean accuracy is 39.44%, 30.99%, and 74.99%, respectively (Tab. 1d–f). That is, counting shapes is not easy to models regardless of whether the shapes are overlapped or nested (Figs. 1 and F34). On nested squares, model accuracies vary widely—GPT-4o (55.83%) and Sonnet-3 (65.00%) are at least -25 points behind Gemini-1.5 (87.08%) and Sonnet-3.5 (92.08%). This gap is even larger on overlapped circles and pentagons—Sonnet-3.5 outperforms other models by multiple times (e.g., 77.71% vs. 1.87% of Sonnet-3; Tab. 1).

    结果：在清点重叠圆、五边形与嵌套正方形上，VLM 的平均准确率分别为 39.44%、30.99% 与 74.99%（表 1d–f）。也就是说，无论形状是重叠还是嵌套，清点形状对模型都不容易（图 1 与图 F34）。在嵌套正方形上，各模型准确率差异很大——GPT-4o（55.83%）与 Sonnet-3（65.00%）至少落后 Gemini-1.5（87.08%）与 Sonnet-3.5（92.08%）25 个点。这一差距在重叠圆与五边形上更大——Sonnet-3.5 以数倍于其他模型的表现胜出（例如 77.71% 对 Sonnet-3 的 1.87%；表 1）。

    All four models are at least 83% accurate in counting 5 circles. Yet, surprisingly, increasing the number of circles by only one causes accuracy to dip substantially to near zero for all models, except Sonnet-3.5 (Fig. 5; column 6–9). In counting pentagons, all VLMs (except Sonnet-3.5) perform poorly even at 5 pentagons. Overall, counting from 6 to 9 shapes (both circles and pentagons) is hard for all models.

    四款模型在清点 5 个圆时准确率都至少为 83%。然而令人意外的是，只把圆的数量增加一个，就会使所有模型的准确率大幅下滑至接近零，Sonnet-3.5 除外（图 5；第 6–9 列）。在清点五边形时，即便只有 5 个五边形，所有 VLM（Sonnet-3.5 除外）也表现很差。总的来看，清点 6 到 9 个形状（圆与五边形皆然）对所有模型都很困难。

    (a) Circles ○   ○   ○ (b) Pentagons ⬠   ⬠   ⬠ (c) Squares
    Number of shapes

    图 5：四款 VLM 都能很好地清点 5 个圆（最左；0.83），但只有 能以 0.9 的准确率很好地清点 5 个重叠五边形（b）。清点 6–9 个形状（ ○ 或 ⬠ ）对 VLM 而言颇具挑战。

    Why are VLMs nearly perfect at counting 5 circles (Fig. 5a), but struggle to count 5 pentagons or more than 5 shapes? When there are more than 5 circles ( ○ ) and VLMs predict an incorrect count, Gemini-1.5 predicts “5” 99.74% of the time regardless of the actual number of circles (Tab. T13). For other models, this frequency is also much higher than that in the case of pentagons. Our results show strong evidence for an explanation that VLMs are biased towards the well-known 5-circle Olympic logo (more results on this bias in Sec. 0.J.4).

    为什么 VLM 在清点 5 个圆时近乎完美（图 5a），却难以清点 5 个五边形或多于 5 个形状？当圆（ ○ ）多于 5 个且 VLM 给出错误计数时，Gemini-1.5 有 99.74% 的情况预测为「5」，而不论实际的圆数是多少（表 T13）。对其他模型而言，这一频率也远高于五边形情形。我们的结果为如下解释提供了有力证据：VLM 对广为人知的奥运五环标志存在偏差（关于该偏差的更多结果见第 0.J.4 节）。

    Note that there are only 2 to 5 squares in each image in the task of counting nested squares, and these squares do not intersect (Fig. F28). Surprisingly, GPT-4o and Sonnet-3 are still unable to perfectly count two and three nested squares (Fig. 5c). When the count increases to four and five, most models are far from 100% accurate (Fig. 5c).

    需注意，在清点嵌套正方形的任务中，每张图像只有 2 到 5 个正方形，且这些正方形互不相交（图 F28）。令人意外的是，GPT-4o 与 Sonnet-3 仍无法完美清点两个与三个嵌套正方形（图 5c）。当数量增至四个与五个时，多数模型远未达到 100% 准确（图 5c）。

    GPT-4o performs better on colored shapes than on black shapes, and Sonnet-3.5 is increasingly better as the image size increases. However, the accuracy of the three other models only changes marginally as colors (Sec. 0.J.3) and image resolutions (Sec. 0.J.2) change.

    GPT-4o 在彩色形状上的表现优于黑色形状，而 Sonnet-3.5 随图像尺寸增大而越来越好。不过，随着颜色（第 0.J.3 节）与图像分辨率（第 0.J.2 节）变化，其余三款模型的准确率仅有微小变动。

    4.5 VLMs cannot reliably count rows and columns in a grid

    4.5 VLM 无法可靠地数清网格的行与列

    Since VLMs struggle with counting simple shapes when the shape edges intersect (Sec. 3.4) or separate (Sec. 3.5), here, we test the remaining case where these shapes are adjacent and share edges. That is, multiple squares tile up into a single grid. Given the impressive accuracy of VLMs [38, 43, 2] on questions involving tables and spreadsheets in DocVQA [31], we hypothesize that VLMs must be able to count rows and columns of a grid.

    既然 VLM 在形状边缘相交（第 3.4 节）或分离（第 3.5 节）时都难以清点简单形状，这里我们测试剩下的一种情形：这些形状相邻且共享边。也就是说，多个正方形平铺成一个网格。鉴于 VLM 在 DocVQA [31] 中涉及表格与电子表格的问题上准确率惊人 [38, 43, 2]，我们假设 VLM 必定能数出网格的行数与列数。

    Experiment   We run all four VLMs on all images of empty grids and text-containing grids (Sec. 3.6) and analyze their formatted answers.

    实验：我们在空网格与含文字网格（第 3.6 节）的全部图像上运行四款 VLM，并分析它们的格式化答案。

    Results   VLMs surprisingly perform poorly (34.37% accuracy) in counting rows and columns in an empty grid (see Tab. T15). Specifically, they are often off by one or two (e.g., GPT-4o predicts 4×\times4 and Gemini-1.5 predicts 5×\times5 for a 4×\times5 grid; Figs. F37 and 1). This finding suggests that VLMs can extract important content from a table to answer table-related questions in DocVQA [31] but do not clearly “see” a table cell-by-cell as a human does.

    结果：VLM 在数空网格的行与列时表现之差令人意外（34.37% 准确率）（见表 T15）。具体地，它们常常相差一或二（例如，GPT-4o 预测为 4×\times4，Gemini-1.5 预测为 5×\times5，而实际网格为 4×\times5；图 F37 与图 1）。这一发现说明，VLM 能从表格中抽取重要内容以回答 DocVQA [31] 中与表格相关的问题，却不能像人类那样逐格清晰地「看见」一张表格。

    (a) Empty (b) Text-containing

    (c) Rows

    (d) Columns

    图 6：分别考察数行（c）与数列（d）的准确率，以及网格为空（a）与含文字（b）时的情形。VLM（尤其是 与 ）在网格含文字时普遍比空网格时数得更准（b 对 a）。有意思的是，对 VLM 而言，数列也比数行更容易（d 对 c）。

    This might be because tables in documents are often non-empty, which are more familiar to VLMs. Aligned with that hypothesis, after adding a single word to each cell, we observe the accuracy of all VLMs to almost double (e.g., from 26.13% to 53.03% for GPT-4o) (Tab. T15). Yet, no models can solve this task with the best model (Sonnet-3.5) performing at 88.68% on text-containing grids and 59.84% on empty grids (Fig. 6a vs. b).

    这可能是因为文档中的表格往往非空，对 VLM 而言更为熟悉。与这一假设相符的是，在每个单元格加入一个单词后，我们观察到所有 VLM 的准确率几乎翻倍（例如 GPT-4o 从 26.13% 升至 53.03%）（表 T15）。然而，没有模型能完美解决该任务——最好的模型（Sonnet-3.5）在含文字网格上为 88.68%，在空网格上为 59.84%（图 6a 对 b）。

    Interestingly, VLMs are better at counting columns than rows—70.53% vs. 60.83% accuracy (Fig. 6c vs. d). However, these numbers are still far from 100% showing that VLMs currently cannot count neither rows or columns in a table reliably. See Secs. 0.K.2 and 0.K.3 for more results.

    有意思的是，VLM 数列比数行更准——70.53% 对 60.83% 准确率（图 6c 对 d）。不过这些数字仍远未达到 100%，说明当前的 VLM 尚不能可靠地数清表格中的行或列。更多结果见第 0.K.2 与 0.K.3 节。

    4.6 VLMs struggle to count single-colored paths

    4.6 VLM 难以清点单色路径

    This path-counting task tests a VLM’s ability in recognizing a path of a unique color and trace it from a given starting station to the destination, an important task in reading maps and graphs in general [30].

    这项路径计数任务考察 VLM 识别某一独特色彩的路径、并从给定起点站追踪到终点站的能力，这是广义上阅读地图与图结构的重要任务 [30]。

    Experiment   From a subway map (Sec. 3.7), we randomly sample 2 connected stations and prompt every model to count the single-colored paths that connect them. We extract numbers from VLM templated responses and compare them with the groundtruth.

    实验：在一张地铁图（第 3.7 节）上，我们随机采样两个相连的站点，并提示每个模型数出连接它们的单色路径条数。我们从 VLM 的模板化回答中抽取数字，与真值比较。

    Results   Overall, VLMs perform poorly at a mean accuracy of 48.90% (Tab. 1h). Even when there is only one path between two stations, no models can reach 100% accuracy (the best is Sonnet-3.5 at 93.33% and the worst is 20%; Fig. F42). VLM predicted counts are often off by 1 to 3 paths (Fig. F45). VLM accuracy reduces substantially, e.g., Sonnet-3.5 from 93.33% to 58.33% and 22.91% as the complexity of the maps increases from 1, 2 to 3 paths, respectively (Fig. F42). More samples of VLM responses are in Figs. 1 and 0.L.4.

    结果：总体来看，VLM 表现很差，平均准确率为 48.90%（表 1h）。即便两站之间只有一条路径，也没有模型能达到 100% 准确率（最好的是 Sonnet-3.5，93.33%；最差的是 20%；图 F42）。VLM 预测的条数常常偏差 1 到 3 条（图 F45）。随着地图复杂度从 1 条增至 2 条、3 条路径，VLM 的准确率大幅下降，例如 Sonnet-3.5 从 93.33% 降至 58.33% 与 22.91%（图 F42）。更多 VLM 回答样例见图 1 与图 0.L.4。

    4.7 Long-inference, slow-thinking VLMs perform similarly to regular VLMs on BlindTest

    4.7 长推理的慢思考 VLM 在 BlindTest 上与常规 VLM 表现相当

    From math to coding, spending more time thinking before responding enables LLMs to perform substantially better in many tasks [16]. Here, we aim to test whether such slow thinking also enables VLMs to perform better on BlindTest where we argue that reasoning in the text space might not help. We perform this test for two SOTA models by comparing them with their corresponding slow-thinking versions.

    从数学到编程，回答前多花时间思考能让大语言模型在许多任务上表现显著更好 [16]。这里我们要检验：在我们主张文本空间中的推理可能无济于事的 BlindTest 上，这种慢思考是否也能让 VLM 表现更好。我们用两款 SOTA 模型，与其对应的慢思考版本作比较，来实施这一检验。

    Experiment   We run 2 SOTA slow-thinking VLMs: Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking and QVQ on BlindTest, and compare them with their non-thinking, regular versions, i.e., Gemini 2.0 Flash and Qwen2-VL.

    实验：我们在 BlindTest 上运行两款 SOTA 慢思考 VLM：Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking 与 QVQ，并把它们与各自的非思考、常规版本（即 Gemini 2.0 Flash 与 Qwen2-VL）作比较。

    表 4：当前最优的慢思考模型（下）在 BlindTest 上甚至比对应的常规版本（上）更差，说明更长的推理对 BlindTest 任务没有正面影响。QVQ 是 Qwen2-VL 的慢思考对应版本。

    Model Size    ○   ○   ○ ⬠   ⬠   ⬠ Task mean
    Gemini 2.0 Flash n/a   85.44 80.95 81.73 55.62 44.16 96.25 66.85 70.97 72.75
    Qwen2-VL 72B   64.97 76.41 73.56 28.12 35.42 74.58 20.64 59.31 54.13
    Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking n/a   77.50 88.24 74.03 47.92 57.08 93.75 70.45 63.75 71.59
    QVQ 72B   37.05 67.26 51.60 29.58 26.66 53.75 36.74 37.22 42.48

    Results   On average over 7 tasks, Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking, is on par with its non-thinking counterpart, Gemini 2.0 Flash (Tab. 4; 71.59 vs 72.75%). This shows that the “slow-thinking” capability (i.e., long, scaled-up inference) does not address the main challenge that BlindTest poses to VLMs. Qualitatively examining the thinking tokens of Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking shows that the hidden thoughts are in text space and have no benefits on BlindTest (see Figs. 7 and 8). Moreover, QVQ, the SOTA open-source slow-thinking model is also -11.65 points behind its non-thinking counterpart, Qwen2-VL (Tab. 4).

    结果：在 7 项任务上平均，Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking 与其非思考对应版本 Gemini 2.0 Flash 持平（表 4；71.59% 对 72.75%）。这说明「慢思考」能力（即长时间的、规模化扩展的推理）并未解决 BlindTest 给 VLM 带来的主要挑战。定性考察 Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking 的思考 token 显示，其隐藏的思考处于文本空间，对 BlindTest 毫无助益（见图 7 与图 8）。此外，QVQ——当前最优的开源慢思考模型——也比其非思考对应版本 Qwen2-VL 低 11.65 个点（表 4）。

    图 7：Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking 即使在思考过程中也无法数清图像中的圆，其回答与其非思考版本（Gemini 2.0 Flash）相似。

    图 8：尽管 Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking 努力追踪类地铁图中的线路，它仍未看见所有连接到 C 点的单色线，给出了与 Gemini 2.0 Flash 相同的错误最终答案。

    5 VLMs can solve most tasks when there is more space between shapes and letters

    5 当形状与字母之间有更多空间时，VLM 能解决多数任务

    Since none of the tested SOTA VLMs, including the slow-thinking ones, is capable of solving any task at near-100% accuracy (Sec. 4), there are two hypotheses to explain this result: (1) prompts may be suboptimal (no prompt-engineering performed); (2) the questions are out-of-distribution for VLMs and they are not capable of solving them, e.g., counting to 10; (3) the shapes being so close together that they are overlapping or nesting or adjacent causes challenges to VLMs in extracting accurate features (and therefore answering questions).

    既然受测的 SOTA VLM（包括慢思考模型）无一能以接近 100% 的准确率解决任何任务（第 4 节），对这一结果有两种解释假说：（1）提示可能不够理想（未做提示工程）；（2）这些问题对 VLM 而言属于分布外，它们没有能力解决，例如数到 10；（3）形状靠得如此之近，以至于相互重叠、嵌套或相邻，造成 VLM 难以提取准确特征（进而难以回答问题）。

    To tease apart hypotheses (1) & (2) from (3), we increasingly add more space between letters and shapes to hopefully make the tasks easier (e.g., space between characters in  or between circles ○   ○   ○ ) and report model-accuracy changes (i.e., how a VLM would reach near 100% accuracy).

    为把假说（1）与（2）同（3）区分开，我们逐步在字母与形状之间加入更多的空间，以期降低任务难度（例如 中字符之间的间距，或圆 ○ ○ ○ 之间的间距），并报告模型准确率的变化（即 VLM 如何接近 100% 准确率）。

    5.1 VLMs perform better as the spacing between letters in the circled letter task increases

    5.1 随着被圈字母任务中字母间距增大，VLM 表现更好

    Experiment   On the circled-letter task ○ , VLMs often cannot reliably tell which letter is being circled among adjacent ones (see Fig. F13). Here, we add 1 to 3 ASCII space characters between adjacent letters of a string and evaluate VLMs using the exact same prompts as done in Sec. 4.3.

    实验：在被圈字母任务 ○ 上，VLM 常常无法可靠判断相邻字母中被圈住的是哪一个（见图 F13）。这里我们在字符串的相邻字母之间加入 1 至 3 个 ASCII 空格字符，并用与第 4.3 节完全相同的提示评估 VLM。

    0 (baseline)
    1
    2
    3
    # of spaces example image
    Number of spaces
    (a) (b)

    图 9：（a）通过在被圈字母任务的基线图像中加入更多空格 ∈{1,2,3}\in\{1,2,3\}，我们得到它们的简化版本。（b）当单词字母之间有 ≥\geq1 个空格时，VLM 普遍表现更好（△\triangle 对 Sonnet-3 与 GPT-4o，从 0 个空格到 3 个空格分别为 +21 与 +13）。

    Results   All VLMs perform better on this task when there is ≥\geq1 extra space between characters compared to when there is no extra space (Fig. 9b). However, the increase (△\triangle) in accuracy varies across models. For instance, and accuracies increase by over +20 points to 92% and 72% from 72% and 46%, respectively (Fig. 9b).

    结果：与没有额外空格时相比，当字符之间多出 ≥\geq1 个空格时，所有 VLM 在该任务上表现更好（图 9b）。不过，准确率的提升幅度（△\triangle）因模型而异。例如， 与 的准确率提升了 20 个点以上，分别从 72% 与 46% 升至 92% 与 72%（图 9b）。

    Out of 7 tested VLMs, Sonnet-3.5 reaches the highest accuracy of 95% when there are 3 extra spaces between letters (Fig. 9a). Qualitatively, the remaining 5% error (40 samples) includes: (1) 12 mispredictions of adjacent letters and (2) 13 instances of confusing the red circle as part of the letter, e.g., ‘@’ for ‘a’, and (3) 15 cases of predicting ‘g’ instead of ‘q’.

    在 7 款受测 VLM 中，当字母之间有 3 个额外空格时，Sonnet-3.5 达到最高准确率 95%（图 9a）。定性地看，剩余 5% 的错误（40 个样本）包括：（1）12 例误判为相邻字母；（2）13 例把红圈误认为字母的一部分，例如把「a」认作「@」；（3）15 例把「q」预测为「g」。

    Note that while the vision encoders in LLaVA-OneV with 72B () and 0.5B () are identical (400M SigLIP), the VLM with a larger Qwen2 language decoder (72B) substantially outperforms the counterpart with smaller decoder (Fig. 9b). This interestingly suggests that, at least in LLaVA-OneV family, the language decoder plays a major role in “reading out” which letter is being circled. On this task there is no slow-thinking [17] required and therefore, the language model (Qwen2) may act as an extended “vision” encoder on top of the SigLIP vision encoder, bottlenecking the accuracy of the LLaVA OneVision-qwen2-si-0.5B ( LLaVA-OneV-S).

    需注意，尽管 72B（）与 0.5B（）版本的 LLaVA-OneV 使用相同的视觉编码器（400M SigLIP），但配备更大 Qwen2 语言解码器（72B）的 VLM 大幅优于配备更小解码器的对应版本（图 9b）。这有意思地提示：至少在 LLaVA-OneV 系列中，语言解码器在「读出」哪个字母被圈住这一点上起着主要作用。该任务不需要慢思考 [17]，因此语言模型（Qwen2）可能充当了 SigLIP 视觉编码器之上的一层扩展「视觉」编码器，成为 LLaVA OneVision-qwen2-si-0.5B（ LLaVA-OneV-S）准确率的瓶颈。

    5.2 VLMs can more accurately count disjoint shapes

    5.2 VLM 能更准确地清点分离的形状

    Inspired by the results of adding spaces to the circled letter task (Sec. 5.1), where VLMs see the letters better when there is more space between them, we also study the effects of the overlap area, i.e., the space between shapes, in counting overlapping shapes (for both ○   ○   ○ and ⬠   ⬠   ⬠ ). We aim to evaluate whether reducing the overlap area between shapes would improve VLM accuracy in counting them.

    受在被圈字母任务中加入空格（第 5.1 节）的结果启发——当字母之间空间更大时 VLM 看得更清楚——我们也研究重叠面积（即形状之间的空间）对清点重叠形状的影响（对 ○ ○ ○ 与 ⬠ ⬠ ⬠ 二者）。我们旨在评估缩小形状之间的重叠面积是否会提升 VLM 清点的准确率。

    Experiment   The overlapping shapes in the baseline images (Sec. 3.4) are distanced in X and Y directions. To generate simplified versions of the images, we gradually increase these distances such that it reduces the overlapping area between the shapes. Specifically, the boundary-to-boundary distance between circles in the original images along the X and Y directions is ∈{d​x×ϕ2,d​y×ϕ2}\in\{dx\times\frac{\phi}{2},dy\times\frac{\phi}{2}\}, where ϕ\phi is the diameter of the circles and d​xdx and d​ydy are multipliers (see Fig. 10). We push the shapes away by increasing d​xdx and d​ydy for circles. We repeat the same procedure for pentagons with the boundary-to-boundary distance of {d×d​x,d×d​y}\{d\times dx,d\times dy\}, where dd is the side length of the pentagons (see Fig. 11). We use the same prompts as in Sec. 3.4 to evaluate VLMs on the new pushed-away sets and compare their accuracy to the baseline results (in Sec. 4).

    实验：基线图像（第 3.4 节）中的重叠形状在 X 与 Y 方向上存在间距。为生成图像的简化版本，我们逐步增大这些间距，以缩小形状之间的重叠面积。具体地，原始图像中圆在 X 与 Y 方向上的边界到边界距离为 ∈{d​x×ϕ2,d​y×ϕ2}\in\{dx\times\frac{\phi}{2},dy\times\frac{\phi}{2}\}，其中 ϕ\phi 是圆的直径，d​xdx 与 d​ydy 是乘数（见图 10）。对圆，我们通过增大 d​xdx 与 d​ydy 把形状推开。对五边形我们重复同样的流程，其边界到边界距离为 {d×d​x,d×d​y}\{d\times dx,d\times dy\}，其中 dd 是五边形的边长（见图 11）。我们用与第 3.4 节相同的提示，在推开后的新图像集上评估 VLM，并把准确率与基线结果（第 4 节）作比较。

    (d​ydy, d​xdx) baseline: (-1.0, 0.1) (-0.75, 0.1) (-0.5, 0.1) (-0.25, 0.1) (0.0, 0.1) (0.25, 0.25) (0.5, 0.5) (0.75, 0.75) (1.0, 1.0)

    图 10：我们通过增大沿 X 轴与 Y 轴的边界到边界距离（即分别为 d​x×ϕ2dx\times\frac{\phi}{2} 与 d​y×ϕ2dy\times\frac{\phi}{2}）来缩小圆之间的重叠面积。

    (d​ydy, d​xdx) baseline: (-0.58, 0.1) (-0.5, 0.1) (-0.25, 0.1) (0.0, 0.1) (0.25, 0.25) (0.5, 0.5) (0.75, 0.75) (1.0, 1.0)

    图 11：我们增大五边形之间沿 X 轴与 Y 轴的边界到边界距离，即分别为 d×d​xd\times dx 与 d×d​yd\times dy。

    Results   VLMs, in general, can count shapes more accurately when there is no overlapping area between shapes (Fig. 12). Yet, accuracy increases vary between models. For example, both Sonnet-3 and Sonnet-3.5 reach ≥\geq96% (Fig. 12; d​x=0.75dx=0.75). Similarly, 72B-LLaVA-OneV () achieves 72% accuracy on counting disjoint circles (Fig. 12; d​x=0.75dx=0.75).

    结果：总的来看，当形状之间没有重叠区域时，VLM 能更准确地清点形状（图 12）。不过准确率的提升因模型而异。例如，Sonnet-3 与 Sonnet-3.5 都达到 ≥\geq96%（图 12；d​x=0.75dx=0.75）。类似地，72B-LLaVA-OneV（）在清点分离圆上达到 72% 准确率（图 12；d​x=0.75dx=0.75）。

    This shows that most VLMs struggle to count the shapes in the baseline images (Fig. 12; d​y=−1dy=-1 and d​x=0.1dx=0.1) because the shapes overlap, which poses a challenge to VLMs in counting.

    这说明多数 VLM 难以清点基线图像中的形状（图 12；d​y=−1dy=-1 与 d​x=0.1dx=0.1），原因在于形状相互重叠，而这给 VLM 的清点带来挑战。

    All closed-source VLMs, except for Gemini-1.5, consistently benefit from increasing the distance along both directions in counting overlapping shapes. The most significant improvement is for Sonnet-3 with △\triangle=91% and the least is for GPT-4o with △\triangle=22% (Fig. 12b). Qualitatively, this is mainly because counting more than 6 shapes is “hard” for Gemini-1.5 regardless of the amount of space between them due to its strong bias towards the Olympic logo (Sec. 4.4).

    除 Gemini-1.5 外，所有闭源 VLM 都一致地受益于在两个方向上增大间距来清点重叠形状。提升最大的是 Sonnet-3（△\triangle=91%），最小的是 GPT-4o（△\triangle=22%）（图 12b）。定性地看，这主要是因为对 Gemini-1.5 而言，无论形状之间留有多少空间，清点 6 个以上形状都是「困难」的，因为它对奥运标志存在很强的偏差（第 4.4 节）。

    Similarly to the circled letter task (Sec. 5.1), 72B LLaVA-OneV performs much better than 0.5B LLaVA-OneV-S on the simplified versions (Fig. 12). This further suggests that the language decoder in LLaVA-OneV significantly affects the VLM’s ability to see, count, and speak the number of shapes in the image.

    与被圈字母任务（第 5.1 节）类似，72B 的 LLaVA-OneV 在简化版本上的表现远好于 0.5B 的 LLaVA-OneV-S（图 12）。这进一步说明，LLaVA-OneV 中的语言解码器显著影响着 VLM 看见、清点并说出图像中形状数量的能力。

    (a) Circles ○   ○   ○ (b) Pentagons ⬠   ⬠   ⬠
    d​ydy ↔\leftrightarrow ,d​x↔dx\leftrightarrow

    图 12：随着我们沿 X 轴与 Y 轴增大圆与五边形之间的间距，VLM 的准确率提升。例如，Sonnet-3.5（）的准确率在 ○ ○ ○ 上从 0.66 升至 1.0（a），在 ⬠ ⬠ ⬠ 上从 0.78 升至 1.0（b）。

    5.3 VLMs can count simplified, more straight paths

    5.3 VLM 能清点简化、更笔直的路径

    VLMs’ ability to count can also affect the overall accuracy of SOTA models on counting single-colored paths ( ) in subway-like maps. To investigate whether VLMs are not able to count in general or whether the zigzag patterns of paths (Fig. 13a) poses the main challenge to VLMs, we render simplified versions of the original maps, where each path in the map contains fewer intersections with other paths. We evaluate the VLMs on the new set and compare their performance with the baseline images.

    VLM 的清点能力也会影响 SOTA 模型在清点类地铁图（ ）中单色路径上的整体准确率。为探究 VLM 究竟是一般而言不会清点，还是路径的锯齿形态（图 13a）才是对 VLM 的主要挑战，我们渲染原图的简化版本，其中每条路径与其他路径的相交更少。我们在新图像集上评估 VLM，并与基线图像上的表现作比较。

    Experiment   We re-render the images by forcing each path to have fewer 90∘90^{\circ} turns than the baseline. The baseline images (Sec. 3.7) are implemented by choosing a direction on a grid using a random depth-first algorithm, where the probability (PP) of choosing a straight direction is 0.33. Therefore, we gradually increase the PP from the baseline (PP=0.33) to 0.6 and 0.9, such that it yields images with fewer intersections and turns (Fig. 13a). We use the prompts in Sec. 3.7 and compare VLMs’ performance with the baseline accuracy.

    实验：我们通过强制每条路径的 90∘90^{\circ} 转折数少于基线来重新渲染图像。基线图像（第 3.7 节）通过在网格上用随机深度优先算法选择方向实现，其中选择直行方向的概率（PP）为 0.33。因此，我们把 PP 从基线（PP=0.33）逐步提高到 0.6 与 0.9，从而得到相交与转折更少的图像（图 13a）。我们使用第 3.7 节的提示，并把 VLM 的表现与基线准确率作比较。

    Results   On average, all VLMs more accurately count the single-colored paths when there are fewer turns, i.e., as PP increases (see Fig. 13b). The accuracy gain significantly varies between models, e.g., +2 points for GPT-4o and +30 for Sonnet-3.5 (Sec. 0.L.3). This shows that SOTA VLMs mostly struggle to count the paths in original images (Sec. 4) due to the visual complexity of zigzag patterns of paths and their intersection.

    结果：平均而言，当转折更少时（即 PP 增大时），所有 VLM 都能更准确地清点单色路径（见图 13b）。准确率增益在模型之间差异显著，例如 GPT-4o 为 +2 个点，Sonnet-3.5 为 +30（第 0.L.3 节）。这说明 SOTA VLM 之所以难以清点原始图像（第 4 节）中的路径，主要是因为路径锯齿形态及其相交带来的视觉复杂性。

    Analyzing the accuracy by the number of paths connected to each station, we find that some VLMs even score near-100 accuracy (e.g., 0.95, 0.99, and 0.95 for , , and , respectively at P=0.9P=0.9; Fig. 13). This substantially better accuracy on simplified images is in stark contrast to the poor accuracy reported for the original subway maps (P=0.33P=0.33), confirming that the visual complexity of the paths poses challenges to VLMs.

    按连接到每个车站的路径条数分析准确率，我们发现部分 VLM 甚至取得接近 100 的准确率（例如 、 、 与 在 P=0.9P=0.9 下分别为 0.95、0.99 与 0.95；图 13）。这种在简化图像上好得多的准确率，与原始地铁图上报告的糟糕准确率（P=0.33P=0.33）形成鲜明反差，印证了路径的视觉复杂性给 VLM 带来了挑战。

    (a) PP values
    0.33 (baseline) 0.6 0.9
    (b)
    1 path 2 paths 3 paths

    图 13：我们提高选择直行（而非转弯）的概率 PP，生成类地铁图的两个简化版本（a）。当把概率 PP 从 0.33 提高到 0.6 与 0.9 时（b），部分 VLM 能达到近乎完美的准确率（Gemini-1.5 在 1 条路径上为 0.99）。

    6 The vision encoder in open-source VLMs can extract sufficient information to solve BlindTest

    6 开源 VLM 的视觉编码器能提取出足以解决 BlindTest 的信息

    We find that VLMs surprisingly fail at simple tasks, e.g., determining whether two circles overlap or not (Sec. 4). Furthermore, our results in Sec. 5 show supporting evidence that these failures are not due to the uncommon nature of the questions in BlindTest or insufficient prompt engineering. Specifically, VLMs achieve near-100% accuracy when there is much more space between shapes and letters (Sec. 5). Therefore, here, we question whether VLMs can “see” the key visual information in BlindTest images, e.g., the gap between two circles in order to decide whether they overlap. Specifically, we run linear probing experiments to test whether the visual encoders of open-source VLMs extract sufficient information for solving BlindTest.

    我们发现 VLM 在简单任务上意外地失败，例如判断两个圆是否重叠（第 4 节）。此外，第 5 节的结果提供了支持性证据，表明这些失败并非源于 BlindTest 中问题的非常规性质，也非提示工程不足。具体地，当形状与字母之间有更多空间时，VLM 能达到接近 100% 的准确率（第 5 节）。因此，这里我们要追问：VLM 能否「看见」BlindTest 图像中的关键视觉信息——例如两个圆之间的间隙 ，以判断它们是否重叠。具体地，我们运行线性探测实验，检验开源 VLM 的视觉编码器是否提取出足以解决 BlindTest 的信息。

    Models   From the SOTA open-source VLM families that we test in Tab. T1, we select two models, 0.5B LLaVA-OneV-S () and 4.2B Phi-3.5 () for two reasons. First, these two VLMs use the two most common vision encoders (VEs)— uses SigLIP [59] while uses CLIP [41]. That is, our findings on these two VEs would generalize to most VLMs. Second, and are among the smallest VLMs, and therefore, if their VEs contain sufficient information, the same is likely true with larger and commercial VLMs.

    模型：从表 T1 中我们所测试的 SOTA 开源 VLM 系列中，我们选出两个模型：0.5B 的 LLaVA-OneV-S（）与 4.2B 的 Phi-3.5（），原因有二。第一，这两款 VLM 使用最常见的两种视觉编码器（VE）—— 使用 SigLIP [59]，而 使用 CLIP [41]。也就是说，我们关于这两种 VE 的发现可推广到多数 VLM。第二， 与 属于最小的 VLM 之列，因此若它们的 VE 含有充足信息，更大、商用的 VLM 很可能同样如此。

    Tasks   We choose (1) the two circles () and (2) the counting line-intersections () for this experiment because they represent arguably the simplest images and questions in BlindTest (the two circles and the line intersections tasks are 2-way and 3-way classification problems).

    任务：我们选择（1）两个圆（）与（2）数直线交点（）用于本实验，因为它们可以说是 BlindTest 中最简单的图像与问题（两圆任务与直线交点任务分别是二分类与三分类问题）。

    We generate 11,100 two-circle images with a uniform distribution of images over circle distances (d​xdx, d​ydy). We divide these images into (8880, 1110, 1110) images for train, val, and test sets, respectively. Repeating this generation process for the line-intersection task () with an equal distribution of mean distances between the y coordinates of the red and blue lines (similar to Fig. 2) for a total of 6,300 images, i.e., divided into (4410, 945, 945) for train, val, and test sets.

    我们生成 11,100 张两圆 图像，图像在圆的间距（d​xdx、d​ydy）上呈均匀分布。我们把这些图像划分为训练集、验证集与测试集，分别为（8880、1110、1110）张。对直线交点任务（）重复同样的生成流程，红蓝两线 y 坐标之间的平均距离均匀分布（类似图 2），共 6,300 张图像，划分为（4410、945、945）用于训练、验证与测试。

    图 14：我们分别在两圆 与折线图 任务上，基于（1）视觉编码器与（2）投影层提取的冻结特征训练线性探测分类器。对线性分类器的评估显示，解决这两项任务所需的信息在投影层前后都存在，却在 LLM 中丢失，导致第 4 节中 VLM 的糟糕准确率。

    Method   We average-pool the image-patch features at the layer right before the projection layer (Fig. 14). Then, we train a logistic-regression linear classifier on top of the frozen features on each task. We train each classifier for 1,000 epochs with L2L_{2} regularization weight of 1.0 (Tab. T18) and choose the best model based on the validation set. The dimensions of the features are described in Sec. 0.N.1. For completeness, we repeat the experiment for the layer right after the projection layer to understand the impact of the projection layer.

    方法：我们在投影层前一层的图像块特征上做平均池化（图 14）。随后，在每个任务的冻结特征之上训练一个逻辑回归线性分类器。每个分类器训练 1,000 轮，L2L_{2} 正则化权重为 1.0（表 T18），并依据验证集选择最佳模型。特征维度见第 0.N.1 节。为完备起见，我们也在投影层后一层重复该实验，以理解投影层的影响。

    Results   The linear-probing accuracy of the CLIP features, before projection layer, in is ≥\geq 99.47% on both tasks (Tab. 5). This suggests that the necessary low-level information to solve these tasks is preserved in CLIP. Similarly, the same conclusion holds for the VE in , a variant of SigLIP, that performs 100% on both tasks (Tab. 5). Moreover, using the frozen features after the projection layer in both and yields a linear classification accuracy of ≥\geq 99.58% on both tasks (Tab. 5). This result shows that most visual information from VEs is preserved before and after the projection layer. Contrasting these high linear-classification VE accuracy scores with fairly lower accuracy of both VLMs on BlindTest (see Tab. 5; rightmost column), we conclude that the language models in these VLMs have access to the necessary visual information to solve BlindTest tasks but fail to decode it into correct language outputs.

    结果：在 中，投影层之前的 CLIP 特征线性探测准确率在两项任务上均为 ≥\geq 99.47%（表 5）。这说明解决这些任务所需的低层信息在 CLIP 中得以保留。同样，（SigLIP 的一个变体）中的 VE 也得出同样结论——它在两项任务上都达到 100%（表 5）。此外，在 与 中使用投影层之后的冻结特征，线性分类准确率在两项任务上均为 ≥\geq 99.58%（表 5）。这一结果表明，来自 VE 的大部分视觉信息在投影层前后都得以保留。把这些很高的 VE 线性分类准确率与两款 VLM 在 BlindTest 上相当低的准确率作对比（见表 5；最右列），我们得出结论：这些 VLM 中的语言模型能够获取解决 BlindTest 任务所需的视觉信息，却未能把它解码为正确的语言输出。

    Interestingly, in the two-circles task, training on frozen features of images, where the two circles are close (d​i​s​t​a​n​c​e=−0.05,0.05distance=-0.05,0.05) produces a linear classifier that performs perfectly at 100% accuracy not only on that training distribution but also on splits containing circles that are farther apart (e.g., d​i​s​t​a​n​c​e=−0.25,0.25distance=-0.25,0.25) regardless of the VE ( and ). However, the opposite does not hold—training on the images where circles are farther apart (d​i​s​t​a​n​c​e=−0.25,0.25distance=-0.25,0.25) results in a classifier that performs poorly on circles that are closer. More details in Sec. 0.N.2. This result shows evidence that (1) training on the harder cases (d​i​s​t​a​n​c​e=−0.05,0.05distance=-0.05,0.05) results in a more robust classifier and (2) our classifiers do not overfit to training data.

    有意思的是，在两圆 任务中，用两个圆靠得较近（d​i​s​t​a​n​c​e=−0.05,0.05distance=-0.05,0.05）的图像的冻结特征训练出的线性分类器，不但在该训练分布上达到 100% 的完美表现，在包含相距更远（例如 d​i​s​t​a​n​c​e=−0.25,0.25distance=-0.25,0.25）的圆的划分上也同样完美，且与所用 VE（ 与 ）无关。反之则不成立——用圆相距更远（d​i​s​t​a​n​c​e=−0.25,0.25distance=-0.25,0.25）的图像训练出的分类器，在圆靠得更近时表现很差。详见第 0.N.2 节。这一结果为两点提供了证据：（1）在更困难的样本（d​i​s​t​a​n​c​e=−0.05,0.05distance=-0.05,0.05）上训练能得到更稳健的分类器；（2）我们的分类器并未过拟合训练数据。

    表 5：LLaVA-OneV-S（）与 Phi-3.5（）中投影层（a）之前的视觉编码器输出特征（分别为 CLIP 与 SigLIP）含有足以解决 与 的信息（线性探测准确率为 ≥\geq 99.47%）。投影层之后（b）也成立同样的结论。然而，这些 VLM 中的语言模型未能把这些信息解码为正确答案，导致任务上的准确率很差（c）。

    7 Related Work

    7 相关工作

    Benchmarking VLM vision understanding   College-level topics [57], charts [30], documents [31] or videos [56] are among the common benchmarks for assessing VLM vision understanding [38, 4, 43, 2] and are witnessing VLMs’ recent rapid progress—e.g., Sonnet-3.5 is reaching 95.2% on DocVQA, 90.8% on ChartQA, and 94.7% on AI2D [2]. However, most of the vision benchmarks attempt to evaluate VLMs on real-world, topic-specific data that require extensive prior knowledge [21, 50, 6], which has a “data leakage” problem, i.e., VLMs many times can answer accurately without even the input image [6]. Furthermore, most benchmarks test VLMs on the data that humans have to deal with to provide a high-level sense of the human-machine intelligence gap [55, 26]. In contrast, our BlindTest benchmark differs significantly from prior benchmarks because it is (1) extremely easy to humans and can be solved by a 5-year-old (unlike [57, 30, 31]); (2) the first low-level, visual sanity check for VLMs; (3) requiring minimal to zero prior knowledge; (4) requiring minimal commonsense or complex reasoning (unlike [8, 58])—i.e., a strong language model is of little use here when it is non-natural for humans to describe BlindTest images in language.

    VLM 视觉理解的基准评测：大学水平的学科 [57]、图表 [30]、文档 [31] 或视频 [56] 是评估 VLM 视觉理解的常见基准 [38, 4, 43, 2]，也见证了 VLM 近期的快速进展——例如 Sonnet-3.5 在 DocVQA 上达到 95.2%、在 ChartQA 上达到 90.8%、在 AI2D 上达到 94.7% [2]。然而，多数视觉基准试图在需要大量先验知识的真实世界、特定领域数据上评估 VLM [21, 50, 6]，这存在「数据泄露」问题，即 VLM 很多时候甚至不需要输入图像就能准确作答 [6]。此外，多数基准在人类必须处理的数据上测试 VLM，以给出人机智能差距的高层印象 [55, 26]。相比之下，我们的 BlindTest 基准与此前基准显著不同，因为它（1）对人类极其简单，五岁小孩即可解决（不同于 [57, 30, 31]）；（2）是首个面向 VLM 的低层视觉有效性检验；（3）只需极少乃至零先验知识；（4）只需极少的常识或复杂推理（不同于 [8, 58]）——也就是说，当人类难以用语言描述 BlindTest 图像时，强大的语言模型在此用处不大。

    The ARC benchmark [36, 8] also contains abstract images made up of simple shapes; however, it challenges VLMs to understand and reason based on those patterns. That is, ARC assumes VLMs can identify the abstract shapes in order to reason. In contrast, our BlindTest directly evaluates VLM capabilities in recognizing these primitive shapes.

    ARC 基准 [36, 8] 同样包含由简单形状构成的抽象图像；不过它要求 VLM 理解这些图案并据此推理，即 ARC 假定 VLM 能够识别这些抽象形状以便推理。相比之下，我们的 BlindTest 直接评估 VLM 识别这些图元形状的能力。

    Improving VLM vision capabilities   Most recent recipes for improving SOTA VLMs involve finetuning a pretrained LLM coupled with vision encoders to solve high-level vision tasks [24]. Such late-fusion approaches fuse visual representations learned from the tokenized image with a powerful thinking brain [33, 23, 22]. However, current vision approaches for VLMs are facing challenges as models sometimes are “blind”—unable to see natural objects exist in a real photo [49]. In contrast, we are showing VLMs are visually impaired at low-level abstract images, e.g., inability to count 6 overlapping circles or 3 nested squares.

    提升 VLM 视觉能力：近期改进 SOTA VLM 的多数方案，都是微调一个预训练 LLM 并配以视觉编码器，以解决高层视觉任务 [24]。这类后期融合方法把从图像 token 化后学到的视觉表征与一个强大的「思考大脑」融合 [33, 23, 22]。然而，当前 VLM 的视觉方案正面临挑战，因为模型有时是「盲」的——看不见真实照片中存在的自然物体 [49]。相比之下，我们表明 VLM 在低层抽象图像上存在视觉缺陷，例如无法清点 6 个重叠圆或 3 个嵌套正方形。

    Our circled-letter task (Sec. 3.3) is inspired by VLM abilities in recognizing content inside a red circle over real objects in natural images [53, 44, 54]. In contrast, we show that VLMs can fail at a low-level, optical character recognition as opposed to recognizing real objects. To the best of our knowledge, no prior attempts have been made to address the exact limitations raised in our paper: (1) identifying and counting simple lines, shapes and geometric primitives when they interact (Sec. 4.1 to Sec. 4.5); (2) following colored paths (Sec. 4.6). Solving these limitations may be the foundation for VLMs to progress on some existing vision benchmarks on graphs, e.g., [19], visual math [27] and some existing blind-spots in natural images (e.g., understanding the direction an object is facing [49]).

    我们的被圈字母任务（第 3.3 节）受启发于 VLM 识别自然图像中真实物体上红圈内内容的能力 [53, 44, 54]。相比之下，我们表明 VLM 会在低层的光学字符识别上失败，而非在识别真实物体上失败。据我们所知，此前尚无工作针对本文提出的确切局限：（1）在直线、形状与几何图元相互作用时识别并清点它们（第 4.1 至 4.5 节）；（2）追踪彩色路径（第 4.6 节）。解决这些局限，可能是 VLM 在图结构相关既有视觉基准（例如 [19]）、视觉数学 [27]，以及自然图像中某些既有盲区（例如理解物体所朝的方向 [49]）上取得进展的基础。

    8 Discussion and Conclusion

    8 讨论与结论

    We propose BlindTest, a benchmark of seven novel low-level visual tasks for testing VLM ability to “see” simple geometric primitives (such as line, circles, squares, intersections) that are the basic building blocks for many image tasks. The tasks are designed from scratch and require minimal to zero knowledge. As the tasks did not exist on the Internet before and require minimal world knowledge, there is minimal chance that VLMs can solve BlindTest by memorization or by not using the input image—an issue in some prior benchmarks [6, 13].

    我们提出 BlindTest——一个包含七项新颖低层视觉任务的基准，用于测试 VLM「看见」简单几何图元（如直线、圆、正方形、交点）的能力，这些图元是许多图像任务的基本构件。这些任务从零开始设计，只需极少乃至零知识。由于这些任务此前不存在于互联网上，且只需极少的常识性知识，VLM 靠记忆或不使用输入图像来解决 BlindTest 的可能性极小——而后者正是某些既有基准存在的问题 [6, 13]。

    Furthermore, we also test common prompting techniques (Sec. 0.D.1) including 2-shot, chain-of-thought [52], and meta-prompting [34] but do not obtain better accuracy, which (1) suggests that VLMs understand BlindTest questions and (2) confirms that these visual tasks do not benefit from thinking aloud [52].

    此外，我们还测试了常见的提示技术（第 0.D.1 节），包括 2-shot、思维链 [52] 与元提示 [34]，但并未获得更好的准确率，这（1）说明 VLM 理解 BlindTest 的问题；（2）印证了这些视觉任务并不能从「出声思考」[52] 中获益。

    The poor performance of VLMs on BlindTest suggests that models will perform poorly on the real-world visual tasks that require them to follow arrow directions or paths, (e.g., reading subway maps in Fig. F46, street maps or directed graphs in Fig. F47), perceive lines and intersections (e.g., reading music sheets; Fig. F47), identify and counts objects in a crowded scene.

    VLM 在 BlindTest 上的糟糕表现提示，模型在需要追踪箭头方向或路径的真实视觉任务上也会表现不佳（例如阅读图 F46 中的地铁图、街道地图或图 F47 中的有向图）、在感知线条与交点上表现不佳（例如阅读乐谱；图 F47），以及在拥挤场景中识别与清点物体上表现不佳。

    On our benchmark, we find that some chat interfaces perform worse than their API counterparts (e.g., the system on gemini.google.com is worse than Gemini-1.5 Pro on aistudio.google.com) perhaps due to their extra finetuning [40] or specific system prompts [32] that attempt to align VLMs with a company’s policies. Similarly, we find GPT-4o and Claude 3 models in perplexity.ai to perform worse than the original API models. To make sure we test the best VLMs available, we access all four models via their available APIs on OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic.

    Appendix 0.C Evaluating open-source models on BlindTest

    附录 0.C 在 BlindTest 上评测开源模型

    On average, 8 well-known open-source models perform worse than the commercial, closed-source VLMs on BlindTest. However, the best-performing open-source model (LLaVA-OneV-72B-ov), performs on-par with Sonnet-3 (45.92 vs. 45.73; Tab. T1). As model size increases, VLMs tend to perform better. For instance, the accuracy increase from LLaVA-OneV-ov 0.5B to 72B is +27.1 (18.82 →\to 45.92; Tab. T1). In sum, open-source VLMs exhibit similar limitations to closed-source models on BlindTest.

    平均而言，8 款知名开源模型在 BlindTest 上的表现不如商用闭源 VLM。不过表现最好的开源模型（LLaVA-OneV-72B-ov）与 Sonnet-3 持平（45.92 对 45.73；表 T1）。随着模型规模增大，VLM 的表现往往更好。例如，从 LLaVA-OneV-ov 0.5B 到 72B，准确率提升了 +27.1（18.82 →\to 45.92；表 T1）。总之，开源 VLM 在 BlindTest 上表现出与闭源模型相似的局限。

    Appendix 0.D Advanced prompting techniques

    附录 0.D 高级提示技术

    0.D.1 Finding: Meta-prompting and 2-shot examples do not improve the VLMs’ performance on the two circles task ()

    0.D.1 发现：元提示与 2-shot 示例并未提升 VLM 在两圆任务（）上的表现

    We run GPT-4o and Sonnet-3.5 on the two circle task () with 2-shot (providing 2 example images with answers) and meta-prompting11 1 Describe the image in detail first, and then answer: Are the two circles overlapping? Y/N. [35]. We find them to perform worse than our baseline prompts (Tab. T2). An explanation is that the VLMs already understand the questions but are limited by the ability to “see”. These techniques are not helpful perhaps because BlindTest tasks intuitively do not benefit from thinking aloud.

    我们在两圆任务（）上用 2-shot（提供 2 张带答案的示例图像）与元提示11 1 先详细描述图像，然后回答：两个圆是否重叠？是/否。 [35] 运行 GPT-4o 与 Sonnet-3.5。我们发现它们的表现不如我们的基线提示（表 T2）。一种解释是，VLM 已经理解了问题，只是受限于「看见」的能力。这些技术之所以无益，或许是因为 BlindTest 任务直观上并不能从出声思考中获益。

    Appendix 0.E Image reconstruction using Sonnet-3.5

    附录 0.E 用 Sonnet-3.5 做图像重建

    Inspired by Pixel Value Prediction [11] task in VLMs, we formulate the tasks in BlindTest as a reconstruction problem. However, we rely on VLMs’ existing capabilities, such as coding, to reform our tasks. Specifically, instead of framing the prompts into question answering, given the input image, we ask the best performing VLM (Sonnet-3.5) to explicitly use its coding ability and reconstruct the input images.

    受 VLM 中的像素值预测 [11] 任务启发，我们把 BlindTest 中的任务表述为一个重建问题。不过我们倚重 VLM 已有的能力（例如编程）来重构我们的任务。具体地，我们不再把提示框定为问答，而是给定输入图像，要求表现最好的 VLM（Sonnet-3.5）显式运用其编程能力来重建输入图像。

    0.E.1 Sonnet-3.5 cannot use its coding ability to regenerate the images from BlindTest

    0.E.1 Sonnet-3.5 无法用其编程能力重现 BlindTest 中的图像

    Experiment   We ask Sonnet-3.5 to generate various formats of the 6 samples from each of 7 tasks in BlindTest, specifically SVG, HTML/CSS, Javascript (using the canvas HTML element to draw the image), and the Python PIL package. We aim to see if the model can maintain the key features of the input image in its generated image, e.g., if Sonnet-3.5 can reconstruct images of the task with the same number of intersections as in the input image.

    实验：我们要求 Sonnet-3.5 为 BlindTest 中 7 项任务各 6 个样本生成多种格式的代码，具体为 SVG、HTML/CSS、Javascript（用 canvas HTML 元素绘制图像）与 Python PIL 包。我们意在考察模型能否在其生成的图像中保留输入图像的关键特征，例如 Sonnet-3.5 能否重建出 任务中交点数与原图一致的图像。

    Results   Overall, the coding ability does not help Sonnet-3.5 to reconstruct the images from BlindTest (see Fig. F2). Furthermore, across various tasks, Sonnet-3.5 often cannot faithfully recreate the important features such as the number of intersections, number of shapes, and touching vs. non-touching circles. This shows that Sonnet-3.5 can see the overall shapes in the image, but it is not sufficient for code generation.

    结果：总的来看，编程能力并未帮助 Sonnet-3.5 重建 BlindTest 中的图像（见图 F2）。此外，在各任务中，Sonnet-3.5 常常无法忠实再现交点数、形状数以及圆相切与否等重要特征。这说明 Sonnet-3.5 能看出图像中的整体形状，但这对代码生成而言并不充分。

    (a) Input image (b) SVG (c) HTML/CSS (d) JavaScript (e) Python

    图 F2：Sonnet-3.5 无法（a）用其编程能力与不同编程语言重现 BlindTest 中的图像。

    Appendix 0.F Two touching circles task

    附录 0.F 两圆相切任务

    0.F.1 Benchmark Construction Details

    0.F.1 基准构建细节

    To create our benchmark, we use 5 parameters to control the diversity of the samples.

    为构建基准，我们用 5 个参数控制样本的多样性。

  • •

    Color: We fix the colors for each circle to use {magenta, dodgerblue}.

    • • 颜色：我们把每个圆的颜色固定为 {magenta, dodgerblue}。

  • •

    Image size: We use the physical size, and the DPI arguments in matplotlib to initialize the image size. The physical size is fixed to 5×55\times 5, and the DPI ∈{100,200,300}\in\{100,200,300\}. The output image sizes are {384, 769, 1155}px.

    • • 图像尺寸：我们用 matplotlib 中的物理尺寸与 DPI 参数初始化图像尺寸。物理尺寸固定为 5×55\times 5，DPI 为 ∈{100,200,300}\in\{100,200,300\}。输出图像尺寸为 {384, 769, 1155}px。

  • •

    Diameter: We use uniform diameters for both circles and choose the value proportional to the image size, where the diameter is {14,15,16,17}\{\frac{1}{4},\frac{1}{5},\frac{1}{6},\frac{1}{7}\} of the image size.

    • • 直径：我们对两个圆使用统一的直径，取值与图像尺寸成比例，直径为图像尺寸的 {14,15,16,17}\{\frac{1}{4},\frac{1}{5},\frac{1}{6},\frac{1}{7}\}。

  • •

    Distance: The boundary-to-boundary distance between circles is a fraction of the diameter chosen from {-0.25, -0.2, -0.15, -0.1, -0.05, 0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.45, 0.5}. Based on our definition, center-to-center distance is (2++distance)×\timesdiameter.

    • • 距离：两圆之间的边界到边界距离是直径的一个分数，取自 {-0.25, -0.2, -0.15, -0.1, -0.05, 0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.45, 0.5}。按我们的定义，圆心距为 (2++距离)×\times直径。

  • •

    Rotation: We include 2 main rotations (vertical and horizontal), and 2 diagonal rotations.

    • • 旋转：我们纳入 2 种主要旋转（垂直与水平）与 2 种对角旋转。

    We use the center of the image as the origin so that it always aligns with the midpoint of distances between two circles. This systematic process results in a benchmark comprising 768 images (see Tabs. T3 and F3).

    我们以图像中心为原点，使其始终与两圆间距的中点对齐。这一系统化流程得到一个含 768 张图像的基准（见表 T3 与图 F3）。

    Code The code is available at https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/TouchingCircle/TwoTouchingCircles.ipynb.

    代码：代码见 https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/TouchingCircle/TwoTouchingCircles.ipynb。

    Prompts

    提示

  • 1.

    Are the two circles touching each other? Answer with Yes/No.

    • 1. 两个圆是否彼此相切？请用是/否回答。

  • 2.

    Are the two circles overlapping? Answer with Yes/No.

    • 2. 两个圆是否重叠？请用是/否回答。

    Groundtruth   We consider two circles overlapping and touching (O{O}, T{T}) if d<0.0d<0.0; non-overlapping but touching (O¯\mkern 1.5mu\overline{\mkern-1.5muO\mkern-1.5mu}\mkern 1.5mu, T{T}) if d=0.0d=0.0; and non-overlapping & non-touching (O¯\mkern 1.5mu\overline{\mkern-1.5muO\mkern-1.5mu}\mkern 1.5mu, T¯\mkern 1.5mu\overline{\mkern-1.5muT\mkern-1.5mu}\mkern 1.5mu) when d>0.0d>0.0 (Fig. F4). Random-baseline accuracy: 50%.
