    0.F.2 Finding: image resolution does not affect VLMs performance

    0.F.2 发现：图像分辨率不影响 VLM 的表现

    Fig. F5-left shows that VLMs are almost invariant to the image resolution. For example, GPT-4o and Sonnet-3’s performance saturates at 769px, and Sonnet-3.5 slightly performs worse at 769 and 1155px compared to 384px. Gemini-1.5, however, is fairly consistent across different resolutions. Based off these results, we conclude that VLMs’ ability to see the intersection of two circles does not depend on the quality of the image.

    图 F5 左图显示，VLM 对图像分辨率几乎不敏感。例如，GPT-4o 与 Sonnet-3 的表现饱和于 769px，而 Sonnet-3.5 在 769 与 1155px 上略逊于 384px。不过 Gemini-1.5 在不同分辨率下相当稳定。基于这些结果，我们得出结论：VLM 看出两个圆是否相交的能力并不取决于图像质量。

    0.F.3 Finding: the vertical rotation closes the gap between models’ performance

    0.F.3 发现：垂直旋转缩小了模型之间的性能差距

    As shown in Fig. F5-middle, arranging the circles in vertical rotation causes the models to perform similarly on the benchmark. Although Gemini-1.5 slightly performs better at diagonal and Sonnet-3.5 at horizontal rotation, VLMs perform relatively better at vertical rotation. This suggests that the task complexity due to various rotations is not the main source of low performance in VLMs.

    如图 F5 中图所示，把圆按垂直方向排列会使各模型在基准上表现相近。虽然 Gemini-1.5 在对角旋转上略好、Sonnet-3.5 在水平旋转上略好，VLM 在垂直旋转上表现相对更好。这说明由各种旋转带来的任务复杂性并非 VLM 表现不佳的主因。

    0.F.4 Finding: Increasing the distance improves the VLMs’ accuracy

    0.F.4 发现：增大间距会提升 VLM 的准确率

    VLMs perform better when the distance increases from zero to positive values (see Fig. F5-right). However, Sonnet-3.5 is more conservative than other VLMs that mostly answer “Yes”, which results in its lowest performance at negative distances.

    当距离从零增至正值时，VLM 表现更好（见图 F5 右图）。不过 Sonnet-3.5 比多数回答「是」的其他 VLM 更为保守，这导致它在负距离上表现最低。

    图 F5：图像的分辨率（左）与 VLM 表现之间没有相关性。在各种旋转下（中），VLM 在垂直方向上的表现几乎相同。多数失败案例出现在临界距离处（右）。

    0.F.5 Finding: VLMs prefer a specific rotation

    0.F.5 发现：VLM 偏好某一种特定的旋转

    Tab. T4 shows that VLMs prefer different rotations. For example, GPT-4o performs best at vertical, Gemini-1.5 at diagonal, Sonnet-3.5 at horizontal, and Sonnet-3 at vertical.

    表 T4 显示，VLM 偏好不同的旋转。例如，GPT-4o 在垂直方向表现最好，Gemini-1.5 在对角方向最好，Sonnet-3.5 在水平方向最好，Sonnet-3 在垂直方向最好。

    表 T4：VLM 的准确率常常在某个特定的两圆朝向上最高。在三种不同分辨率下，当两个圆垂直排列时，GPT-4o 与 Sonnet-3 的表现好得多。相比之下，Gemini-1.5 与 Sonnet-3.5 分别偏好对角与水平朝向。

    0.F.7 Results for fine-tuning Bunny on the two touching circle

    0.F.7 在两圆相切任务上微调 Bunny 的结果

    In order to determine if fine-tuning could improve the model’s performance on this task we attempted to fine-tune Bunny [12] (Bunny-v1.1-Llama-3-8B-V with the original weights) on the two touching circles task. We fine-tuned Bunny using datasets of sizes: 10K, 20K, 50K, and 100K samples, each containing a balanced number of instances where the circles are either overlapping or separate (equal number of YES/NO answers in the training set).

    为判断微调能否提升模型在该任务上的表现，我们尝试在两圆相切任务上微调 Bunny [12]（Bunny-v1.1-Llama-3-8B-V，使用原始权重）。我们用规模为 10K、20K、50K 与 100K 样本的数据集微调 Bunny，每个数据集中圆重叠与圆分离的样本数量均衡（训练集中「是」与「否」答案数量相等）。

    The baseline model, without any fine-tuning, achieved 17.1% accuracy for task overlap and 11.7% for touching circles. After fine-tuning, we observed improvements with smaller datasets, such as 10K and 20K cases, where accuracy reached up to 36.8%. However, increasing the number of samples did not lead to better performance. In some instances, such as with the 50K dataset, the model failed to predict anything and only generated the end-of-text token.

    未做任何微调的基线模型在重叠任务上取得 17.1% 准确率，在相切圆任务上取得 11.7%。微调后，我们在较小的数据集（如 10K 与 20K 样本）上观察到改进，准确率最高达到 36.8%。然而，增加样本数并未带来更好的表现。在若干情形下（例如使用 50K 数据集时），模型无法做出任何预测，只生成文本结束 token。

    The loss values for all these experiments were very close to zero, indicating that the model overfits the training set but fails to generalize. This suggests that training on this task is not straightforward and may require a combination of multiple tasks or that this problem does not have a simple solution.

    所有这些实验的损失值都非常接近于零，说明模型过拟合了训练集却无法泛化。这表明在该任务上训练并非易事，可能需要多个任务的组合，或者该问题本就没有简单的解法。

    Fig. F6 shows the accuracy breakdown by distance of the two circles. The model’s performance improves when the circles are overlapping, but when there is a long distance between them, the model does not generalize well and cannot provide accurate answers.

    图 F6 展示了按两圆距离细分的准确率。当圆重叠时模型表现提升，但当两圆相距较远时，模型泛化不佳，无法给出准确答案。

    Appendix 0.G Task 3: Identifying the circled letter in a string

    附录 0.G 任务 3：识别字符串中被圈住的字母

    0.G.1 Task construction

    0.G.1 任务构建

    Each image is created using a combination of the below variables.

    每张图像由下列变量组合生成。

  • •

    String: We test three strings { Acknowledgement , Subdermatoglyphic ,
    tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM }. While they all have letters of varying widths and heights, the first two are English words while the latter is a string of random characters. Subdermatoglyphic is the longest English word that has no letter repetitions.

    • • 字符串：我们测试三个字符串 { Acknowledgement ， Subdermatoglyphic ， tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM }。虽然它们的字母宽度与高度各异，但前两个是英文单词，最后一个是随机字符组成的字符串。Subdermatoglyphic 是不含字母重复的最长英文单词。

  • •

    Letter: We draw the oval () over every letter, one at a time, in each string.

    • • 字母：我们在每个字符串中把椭圆（）逐个绘制在每个字母上。

  • •

    Font: We use 2 different font families for each word, OpenSans and Helvetica.

    • • 字体：我们为每个单词使用 2 种不同的字体族，OpenSans 与 Helvetica。

  • •

    Oval () thickness: We generate the with 3 various line thicknesses.

    • • 椭圆（）粗细：我们用 3 种不同的线条粗细生成 。

  • •

    Scaling factor: Since each letter has a unique size, we use a scaling factor to control the size of the .

    • • 缩放因子：由于每个字母尺寸各异，我们用一个缩放因子控制 的大小。

    Finally, we render the text on a white canvas with a size of 1250×\times1250 pixels, and we produce 90 images for Acknowledgement , 102 for Subdermatoglyphic , and 120 samples for tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM (see Tabs. T6 and F9).

    最后，我们把文本渲染在 1250×\times1250 像素的白色画布上，并为 Acknowledgement 生成 90 张、 Subdermatoglyphic 生成 102 张、 tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM 生成 120 张样本（见表 T6 与图 F9）。

    0.G.2 Finding: VLMs mostly confuse the adjacent character for the circled letter

    0.G.2 发现：VLM 多半把相邻字符误认为被圈住的字母

    Models often mistake the neighboring characters as actual circled letters. For example, Fig. F11 shows that for Sonnet-3.5 in the word Acknowledgement , all of the incorrect predictions for “n” are the neighboring letter “t”. For Gemini-1.5, in the word tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM , where letters “K” and “a” are adjacent, 100% of the mispredictions for “K” are the letter “a” (see Fig. F12).

    模型常把相邻字符误当作真正被圈住的字母。例如，图 F11 显示，对 Sonnet-3.5 在单词 Acknowledgement 中，针对「n」的全部错误预测都是相邻字母「t」。对 Gemini-1.5 在 tHyUiKaRbNqWeOpXcZvM 中，字母「K」与「a」相邻，针对「K」的错误预测 100% 都是字母「a」（见图 F12）。

    图 F11：相邻字母是 Sonnet-3.5 在 Acknowledgement 中最常见的错误预测，例如有 20.83% 的情况把「m」预测为「e」，或 27.08% 的情况把「n」预测为「t」。

    图 F12：Gemini-1.5 倾向于混淆「a」与「K」等相邻字母。Gemini-1.5 还会把被圈住的字母「a」幻觉为字符「@」，并把字母「q」误认为字母「g」。

    图 F13：对单词 Subdermatoglyphic 中每个字母，汇总四款 VLM 各 12 条回答得到的混淆矩阵。模型多半误预测被圈字母附近的字符。VLM 有时会幻觉出该单词中根本不存在的字符，例如「@」（右图）。

    0.G.3 Finding: GPT-4o and Gemini-1.5 confuse the red oval as part of the letter

    0.G.3 发现：GPT-4o 与 Gemini-1.5 把红色椭圆误认为字母的一部分

    Figs. F14 and F15 show that Gemini-1.5 and GPT-4o sometimes fail to recognize that the red oval is not part of the letter. Gemini-1.5 tends to predict that the circled letter “a” is actually the “@” sign (see Fig. F14). GPT-4o on the other hand tends to predict “o” regardless of which letter is circled (Fig. F15).

    图 F14 与图 F15 显示，Gemini-1.5 与 GPT-4o 有时无法识别红色椭圆并非字母的一部分。Gemini-1.5 倾向于把被圈住的字母「a」预测为「@」符号（见图 F14）。GPT-4o 则倾向于不论哪个字母被圈住都预测「o」（图 F15）。

    Appendix 0.H Counting the number of line intersections task

    附录 0.H 数直线交点数量任务

    0.H.1 Benchmark Construction Details

    0.H.1 基准构建细节

    To create our benchmark, we use 5 parameters to control the diversity of the samples.

    为构建基准，我们用 5 个参数控制样本的多样性。

  • •

    Color: We fix the colors for each line to use {blue, red}

    • • 颜色：我们把每条线的颜色固定为 {蓝，红}。

  • •

    Image size: We generate 3 different image resolutions, {384, 768, 1152}px, to include high and low-resolution samples in our tests.

    • • 图像尺寸：我们生成 3 种不同的图像分辨率 {384, 768, 1152}px，以在测试中包含高分辨率与低分辨率样本。

  • •

    Grid size: We divide the whole image into a 12×\times12 grid with 144 equal sized cells. Then, we choose 3 points for each (blue and red) line on the grid to draw the line plots. To make sure the line plots do not overlap and the intersections are well distanced from the edges, we fix the x-coordinates, and randomly sample y-coordinates from the invisible 12×\times12 grid. The grid sampling also avoids picking the same coordinates for both blue and red line.

    • • 网格尺寸：我们把整幅图像划分为 12×\times12 的网格，含 144 个等大单元格。然后，我们为每条（蓝、红）线在网格上选取 3 个点以绘制折线。为确保折线不重叠、且交点与边缘保持充分距离，我们固定 x 坐标，并从不可见的 12×\times12 网格中随机采样 y 坐标。网格采样也避免为蓝线与红线选中相同坐标。

  • •

    X-coordinate: For each point, we choose x=0,C2,C=0,\frac{C}{2},C px.

    • • X 坐标：对每个点，我们取 x=0,C2,C=0,\frac{C}{2},C px。

  • •

    Y-coordinate: For each x-coordinate above, we randomly sample a y-coordinate from 12 pre-defined rows in the 12×\times12 grid. We also ensure that no blue and red points share the exact same (x,y) coordinates.

    • • Y 坐标：对上面每个 x 坐标，我们从 12×\times12 网格中预定义的 12 行里随机采样一个 y 坐标。我们还确保蓝点与红点不共用完全相同的 (x, y) 坐标。

  • •

    Line thickness: We vary the line widths with standard matplotlib values (2 and 4), which renders into a width of 0.005×C0.005\times C and 0.01×C0.01\times C pixels, respectively.

    • • 线条粗细：我们用 matplotlib 的标准取值（2 与 4）改变线宽，分别渲染为 0.005×C0.005\times C 与 0.01×C0.01\times C 像素的宽度。

  • •

    Number of intersections: We count the intersections based on the three points defined for each line ((x,y1)(x,y_{1}), (x,y2)(x,y_{2}), and (x,y3)(x,y_{3})).

    • • 交点数量：我们依据为每条线定义的三个点（(x,y1)(x,y_{1})、(x,y2)(x,y_{2}) 与 (x,y3)(x,y_{3})）统计交点。

    We repeat the process until we have 2 line widths×\times3 image sizes×\times100 samples of 0, 1, and 2 intersections, resulting in 1800 images (see Tabs. T9 and F20).

    我们重复该流程，直到得到 2 种线宽×\times3 种图像尺寸×\times 各 100 个含 0、1、2 个交点的样本，共 1800 张图像（见表 T9 与图 F20）。

    Code   The code to generate the images is at https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/LineIntersection/2dline.ipynb.

    代码：生成图像的代码见 https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/LineIntersection/2dline.ipynb。

  • 2.

    Count the intersection points where the blue and red lines meet. Put your answer in curly brackets, e.g., {2}.

    • 2. 数一数蓝线与红线相交的交点。把答案放在花括号中，例如 {2}。

    Groundtruth answers are ∈{0,1,2}\in\{0,1,2\} (random-baseline accuracy: 33.33%).

    真值答案为 ∈{0,1,2}\in\{0,1,2\}（随机基线准确率：33.33%）。

    Appendix 0.I Counting the number of nested squares

    附录 0.I 数嵌套正方形的数量

    0.I.1 Benchmark Construction Details

    0.I.1 基准构建细节

    We use 5 parameters to create the images of nested squares.

    我们用 5 个参数生成嵌套正方形的图像。

  • •

    Depth: For each image, we draw N∈{2,3,4,5}N\in\{2,3,4,5\} nested squares on the image. We refer to each square in this collection as a depth.

    • • 层数：对每张图像，我们绘制 N∈{2,3,4,5}N\in\{2,3,4,5\} 个嵌套正方形。我们把该集合中的每个正方形称为一层。

  • •

    Initial size: We choose a random size for the first square in the bounds of the image size.

    • • 初始尺寸：我们在图像尺寸的边界内为第一个正方形随机选取一个尺寸。

  • •

    Reduction factor: We draw squares such that each depth is entirely contained by its previous depth. We use a reduction factor to scale the square sizes.

    • • 缩减因子：我们绘制正方形，使每一层都完整包含于其前一层之内。我们用一个缩减因子来缩放正方形的尺寸。

  • •

    Center: The first square’s center is chosen to ensure it is entirely visible in the image. For the remaining squares, we choose the center based on the space between the previous square and the new reduced size.

    • • 中心：第一个正方形的中心被选取为使其在图像中完整可见。对余下的正方形，我们依据前一个正方形与新的缩减尺寸之间的空间来选择中心。

  • •

    Line thickness: We use standard matplotlib line width parameter of (2=3px, 3=4px, 4=6px).

    • • 线条粗细：我们使用 matplotlib 的标准线宽参数（2=3px、3=4px、4=6px）。

    We continue to generate images until we have 30 samples for each depth, resulting in 120 images overall (see Tabs. T10 and F25).

    我们持续生成图像，直到每层各有 30 个样本，共 120 张图像（见表 T10 与图 F25）。

    Code The code is available at https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/NestedSquares/GenerateSamples.ipynb.

    代码：代码见 https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/NestedSquares/GenerateSamples.ipynb。

    Post-processing:   To determine the model’s answer, we use Python to extract the number from curly braces in the response e.g. {3}.

    后处理：为判定模型的答案，我们用 Python 从回答的花括号中抽取数字，例如 {3}。

  • 2.

    Count total number of squares in the image. Answer with only the number in numerical format in curly brackets e.g. {3}.

    • 2. 数出图像中正方形的总数。只用数字格式作答，放在花括号中，例如 {3}。

    Groundtruth answers are ∈{2,3,4,5}\in\{2,3,4,5\} (random-baseline accuracy: 25%).

    Appendix 0.J Counting the shapes in an Olympic-like logo

    附录 0.J 清点类奥运标志中的形状

    0.J.1 Benchmark Construction Details

    0.J.1 基准构建细节

    We create the benchmark by generating images containing shapes resembling the Olympic logo by choosing a combination of settings.

    我们通过选取一组设置的组合，生成含有类似奥运标志形状的图像来构建基准。

  • •

    Image size: We fix the physical size of the image in matplotlib to 5×\times5, and change the resolution by changing the DPI value, which is ∈{100,200,300}\in\{100,200,300\} to get images with sizes {384,769,1155}\{384,769,1155\}px.

    • • 图像尺寸：我们把 matplotlib 中图像的物理尺寸固定为 5×\times5，并通过改变 DPI 值（即 ∈{100,200,300}\in\{100,200,300\}）来改变分辨率，得到尺寸为 {384,769,1155}\{384,769,1155\}px 的图像。

  • •

    Number of shapes: We choose a number from {5, 6, 7, 8, 9}.

    • • 形状数量：我们从 {5, 6, 7, 8, 9} 中选取一个数字。

  • •

    Color: Each image is generated using two different coloring schemes. We generate an all-black version and a second version by randomly sampling colors from a colormap in matplotlib.

    • • 颜色：每张图像用两种不同配色方案生成。我们生成一个全黑版本，以及第二个版本——从 matplotlib 的色图中随机采样颜色。

  • •

    Distance: To generate the interlaced shapes, we use a small boundary-to-boundary distance factor for each row of the shapes. We fix this value to 0.1 proportional to the diameter of circles or side length of pentagons.

    • • 距离：为生成交错的形状，我们为每一行形状使用一个小的边界到边界距离因子。我们把该值固定为圆直径或五边形边长的 0.1 倍。

  • •

    Diameter: We choose a uniform diameter for all the circles in each image from {17,110}\{\frac{1}{7},\frac{1}{10}\} proportional to the image size.

    • • 直径：我们为每张图像中的所有圆选取统一的直径，取值为图像尺寸的 {17,110}\{\frac{1}{7},\frac{1}{10}\}。

  • •

    Side length: We follow the same policy for the diameter to choose the side length of the pentagons.

    • • 边长：我们对五边形的边长采取与直径相同的策略选取。

  • •

    Line thickness: We generate each image with {0.5, 1.0} line width of matplotlib standard. This results in {1px, 2px} lines in 384px images, {2px, 3px} lines in 769px images and {3px, 5px} lines in 1155px images.

    • • 线条粗细：我们用 matplotlib 标准的 {0.5, 1.0} 线宽生成每张图像。这在 384px 图像中产生 {1px, 2px} 线条，在 769px 图像中产生 {2px, 3px} 线条，在 1155px 图像中产生 {3px, 5px} 线条。

    We center the shape collection on the center of the image in two rows, and generate 480 images (see Figs. F29 and T12), 240 images of circles, and 240 images of pentagons.

    我们把形状集合分两行居中置于图像中心，生成 480 张图像（见图 F29 与表 T12），其中圆 240 张、五边形 240 张。

    Code The code is available at https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/CountingCircles/OlympicCircles.ipynb for circles and at https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/CountingCircles/OlympicPentagons.ipynb for pentagons.

    代码：圆的生成代码见 https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/CountingCircles/OlympicCircles.ipynb，五边形的生成代码见 https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/CountingCircles/OlympicPentagons.ipynb。

    Count the {shapes} in the image. Answer with a number in curly brackets e.g. {3}.

    • 2. 数一数图像中的 {形状}。用花括号中的数字回答，例如 {3}。

    where {shapes} = circles or pentagons.

    其中 {形状} = 圆或五边形。

    Groundtruth answers are ∈{5,6,7,8,9}\in\{5,6,7,8,9\} (random-baseline accuracy: 20%).

    真值答案为 ∈{5,6,7,8,9}\in\{5,6,7,8,9\}（随机基线准确率：20%）。

    Appendix 0.K Counting the rows and columns of a grid task

    附录 0.K 数网格行与列的任务

    0.K.1 Benchmark Construction Details

    0.K.1 基准构建细节

    Our benchmark specifications consist of various parameters for the grid generation process.

    我们的基准规格包含网格生成过程中的各种参数。

  • •

    Image size: We include three different sizes {500, 1250, 2000} to create the grids on the image.

    • • 图像尺寸：我们纳入三种不同尺寸 {500, 1250, 2000} 来在图像上创建网格。

  • •

    Number of rows/columns: We choose a base size N∈{3,4,5,6,7,8,9}N\in\{3,4,5,6,7,8,9\}, and initialize the sizes to N×NN\times N, N×N′N\times N^{\prime}, and N′×NN^{\prime}\times N where N′=N+1N^{\prime}=N+1. We also create 10×\times10 grids to balance the square grids.

    • • 行数/列数：我们选取一个基准尺寸 N∈{3,4,5,6,7,8,9}N\in\{3,4,5,6,7,8,9\}，并把尺寸初始化为 N×NN\times N、N×N′N\times N^{\prime} 与 N′×NN^{\prime}\times N，其中 N′=N+1N^{\prime}=N+1。我们也创建 10×\times10 网格，以与方形网格保持均衡。

  • •

    Line thickness: We use a line thickness of 1% of the image size and 0.5% of the image size.

    • • 线条粗细：我们使用为图像尺寸 1% 与 0.5% 的线条粗细。

  • •

    Entry: Each table is generated in two versions, one that includes blank entries, and the second with random text entries.

    • • 内容：每张表格生成两个版本，一个含空白单元格，另一个含随机文字内容。

    We divide the image size by the number of rows and columns to find the coordinates for drawing the borderlines. Then, we draw the lines on the four edges of the image and draw the remaining lines in between. Our benchmark comprises 264 images of blank and text-containing grids (see Tabs. T14 and F35).

    我们用图像尺寸除以行数与列数，求得绘制边框线的坐标。然后我们在图像的四条边上画线，并在其间绘制余下的线。我们的基准包含 264 张空白与含文字网格的图像（见表 T14 与图 F35）。

    Code The code is available at https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/CountingRowsAndColumns/Grids.ipynb.

    代码：代码见 https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/CountingRowsAndColumns/Grids.ipynb。

    0.K.2 Finding: VLMs cannot reliably count either rows or columns

    0.K.2 发现：VLM 无法可靠地数清行或列

    Appendix 0.L Following single-colored paths task

    附录 0.L 追踪单色路径任务

    0.L.1 Benchmark Construction Details

    0.L.1 基准构建细节

    Our subway-like graphs are generated using a set of parameters defining the characteristics of the plot.

    我们的类地铁图由一组定义图形特征的参数生成。

  • •

    Image size: We use two different sizes {512, 1024}px for the images to include various resolutions.

    • • 图像尺寸：我们用两种不同的尺寸 {512, 1024}px 生成图像，以涵盖各种分辨率。

  • •

    Grid size: We assume a hypothetical grid on the image that determines the position of the paths. We used an 18×\times18 grid, which means each path segment is 118\frac{1}{18} of the image size.

    • • 网格尺寸：我们在图像上假设一个决定路径位置的网格。我们使用 18×\times18 的网格，这意味着每段路径为图像尺寸的 118\frac{1}{18}。

  • •

    Number of stations: We use four station labels, {A, B, C, D}.

    • • 车站数量：我们使用四个车站标签 {A, B, C, D}。

  • •

    Starting points: Each station in our maps has three different starting points which are exactly 118\frac{1}{18} of the image size to one side of the stations.

    • • 起点：我们地图中的每个车站有三个不同的起点，恰好位于距车站一侧 118\frac{1}{18} 图像尺寸处。

  • •

    Path thickness: We use two line thicknesses, 10 and 20 pixels to have bold and light visualizations of the same path.

    • • 路径粗细：我们使用 10 与 20 像素两种线宽，以呈现同一路径的粗、细两种可视化效果。

  • •

    Number of paths: Considering the number of starting points in our setup, each image can include stations from which exactly 1, 2, or 3 paths exit.

    • • 路径数量：考虑到我们设置中的起点数量，每张图像可以包含恰好发出 1、2 或 3 条路径的车站。

    We keep generating the images until we have 15 samples for each number of paths which results in 180 images (see Tabs. T17 and F40).

    我们持续生成图像，直到每种路径数量各有 15 个样本，共 180 张图像（见表 T17 与图 F40）。

    Code The code is available at https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/SubwayMap/SubwayMap.ipynb

    代码：代码见 https://github.com/anguyen8/vision-llms-are-blind/blob/main/src/SubwayMap/SubwayMap.ipynb

    Count the one-colored routes that go from {station 1} to {station 2}. Answer with a number in curly brackets, e.g., {3}.

    • 2. 数一数从 {车站 1} 到 {车站 2} 的单色路线。用花括号中的数字回答，例如 {3}。

    where the two stations are different and sampled from { A, B, C, D }\{\text{ {{\footnotesize A}}, {{\footnotesize B}}, {{\footnotesize C}}, {{\footnotesize D}} }\}.

    0.L.2 Finding: VLMs fail to see the colored paths across various map complexities

    0.L.2 发现：VLM 在各种地图复杂度下都看不见彩色路径

    All VLMs, except Sonnet-3, start to perform worse as the number of paths per station increases in the images of subway-like maps (Fig. F42).

    在类地铁图图像中，随着每个车站的路径数量增加，除 Sonnet-3 外的所有 VLM 表现都开始变差（图 F42）。

    图 F42：随着路径数量从 1 增至 3，VLM 的准确率下降。总的来看，清点彩色路径对 VLM 构成挑战。

    0.L.3 Sonnet-3.5 can more accurately count subway paths on simplified images compared to other VLMs

    0.L.3 Sonnet-3.5 在简化图像上比其他 VLM 更能准确定位地铁路径

    Sonnet-3.5 consistently benefits from increasing the probability of choosing the straight path across all image settings (Fig. F43), suggesting its counting ability is generally better than other VLMs, and perhaps the complexity of images is the reason for its initial low performance.

    Sonnet-3.5 在所有图像设置下都一致地受益于提高选择直行路径的概率（图 F43），说明其清点能力总体优于其他 VLM，而图像复杂性或许正是它起初表现不佳的原因。

    图 F43：当我们把选择直行路径的概率从 P=P= 0.33 提高到 0.9 时，Sonnet-3.5 的平均性能增益最大（+27）。

    0.N.2 Additional results

    0.N.2 补充结果

    The linear classifier, i.e., logistic regression, performs with 99% accuracy on the two circles (Fig. F48) and the line charts tasks (Fig. F49), when trained and tested on the images with the same visual complexities (Figs. F48 and F49; diagonal axis highlighted with black outline).

    当在视觉复杂度相同的图像上训练与测试时（图 F48 与图 F49；对角线轴以黑色轮廓高亮），线性分类器（即逻辑回归）在两圆（图 F48）与折线图（图 F49）任务上达到 99% 的准确率。

    Moreover, transferring the classifier trained in small to large gaps shows an accuracy comparable to the baseline accuracy of these VLMs, suggesting the sufficiency of frozen features for solving the selected tasks from BlindTest.

    此外，把在小间距上训练的分类器迁移到大间距上，其准确率与这些 VLM 的基线准确率相当，说明冻结特征足以解决 BlindTest 中所选定的任务。
